Software Engineering Manager - Sustaining Engineering

3 days ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Join to apply for the Software Engineering Manager - Sustaining Engineering role at Canonical

Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1100+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder led, profitable and growing.

We are hiring a Engineering Manager for Sustaining Engineering passionate about open source software, Linux and cloud computing. Come build a rewarding, meaningful career working with the best and brightest people in technology at Canonical, the growing international software company behind Ubuntu.

Sustaining Engineering is a business critical team that continuously improves various open source software by resolving software defects reported by customers. Software stack includes everything from the kernel all the way up to the user space applications and IaaS platforms. This position leads one of our regional teams and is one of several managers, who report directly to the global Director of Sustaining Engineering.

Our customers build large-scale mission critical infrastructure and application solutions on Ubuntu and open source from Canonical. While not actively developing products, Sustaining Engineering, as part of Support Engineering, solves problems for the customer and for the benefit of the wider Open Source community. This team is well staffed with experts in every time zone and, while the work can be challenging sometimes, the team is resourced to ensure a good work-life balance and ongoing development of each team member.

As an engineering manager in the Sustaining Engineering team, your primary responsibility is to the people you support: ensuring that they are growing as engineers, making valuable contributions, and generally having a great experience at Canonical. Technical leadership and a solid background in software development are a must, so that you are able to help your team members grow professionally. You will have the opportunity to influence the culture, facilitate technical delivery, and work with your team on strategy and execution.

Location: This is a globally remote role, unless specified otherwise.

The role entails

  • Manage and lead a distributed team of engineers
  • Hire, coach, mentor, provide feedback and career development guidance to your team
  • Manage & measure key performance indicators (KPIs), and training
  • Support timely delivery of bug fixes, patches, and other technical solutions to address business needs in a variety of technology fields, including but not limited to Ubuntu, OpenStack, Ceph, Kubernetes, Juju & MAAS
  • Demonstrate the very best of Canonical in customer interactions
  • Set and manage expectations with other engineering teams, senior management, and external stakeholders
  • Advocate and advance modern software development practices
  • Grow a healthy, collaborative engineering culture in line with the company value
  • Collaborate with other teams in the organisation
  • Work from home with global travel up to 10% for internal and external events

What we are looking for in you

  • Professional software delivery experience using C, C++, Go, Python, or similar
  • You are knowledgeable and passionate about software development
  • Leadership experience displaying ability to organise and prioritise complex problem resolution and bug fixes
  • Experience with version control systems such as git
  • Experience with debugging tools such as gdb, crash or other
  • Demonstrated strong commitment to testing methodologies and maintainable code quality
  • Excellent communication skills in the English language, both verbal and written
  • Experience with Linux, with a preference towards Ubuntu
  • Experience with Open Source and Open Source Business Models
  • People management experience in a support organisation is a strong plus

What we offer colleagues

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Somos o vizinho especialista em produtos frescos e naturais, com qualidade impecável e uma experiência que faz o cliente se sentir em casa.
Nossa alma é de feirante: gostamos de conversar, sorrir e oferecer aquele conforto emocional das feiras livres da infância, com um atendimento próximo, humano e cheio de alegria.

Realizar a limpeza e conservação de peixes e frutos do mar preparando variadas refeições da cozinha oriental, conforme sortimento da empresa, verificando e garantindo a qualidade, frescor, aparência, exposição e organização da área de vendas para atendimento dos nossos clientes.

title: Chief Operating Officer (COO)
description:
InPlanet is a mission-driven, remote-first ClimateTech startup with hubs in Sao Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, New York, and London. We are scaling Enhanced Rock Weathering (ERW) in tropical agriculture to remove carbon, regenerate soils, and transform food production in the tropics.
Our vision is to sequester gigatons of CO2 while regenerating tropical soils, creating a livable planet with nutritious food and healthy ecosystems for future generations. We collaborate with farmers, scientists, and industry leaders and are experiencing rapid growth.
Our culture emphasizes people-first care and performance excellence . The Rocket symbolizes our ambition; the Heart reflects our empathy, integrity, and collective impact.
We pride ourselves on a diverse, inclusive team, primarily based in Brazil, where the climate impact is most significant. You can read reviews on Glassdoor about our interview process.

Check out our Culture page here.

About the Role

Location: Brazil (São Paulo or surrounding regions preferred)
Language Skills: Portuguese, English (fluent)
Start Date: Ideally Q3/4 2025

We seek a seasoned, strategic, and hands-on COO to lead our go-to-market strategy for mineral-based carbon removal products across agriculture and mining sectors . You will oversee our entire value chain, from mineral inputs and field operations to our science engine and technology roadmap. This senior role combines bold strategy with operational precision to scale our impact.
Your role involves refining product-market fit , identifying scalable customer use cases , and leading the integration of deployment, scientific standards, and operational scaling. You will collaborate closely with our Chief Impact Officer and Head of Operations on regional management and logistics, and with our VP of Science to align field strategy with scientific standards and climate goals. You will ensure our product offers agronomic value and meets carbon certification standards, scaling pilots into high-impact operations at a national level.
The ideal candidate has a strong operational track record , preferably in Brazilian agribusiness , capable of bridging execution with innovation .
You will report directly to the CEO and be a key member of the Senior Leadership Team , leading a growing team including:

  • Head of Operations and project deployment teams
  • Strategic partners including the Chief Impact Officer and commercial teams
  • Close collaboration with the VP of Science
  • Coordination with Carbon and Technology teams
About InPlanet

InPlanet is a ClimateTech startup with hubs across Germany, Brazil, and the US, focusing on scaling ERW in tropical agriculture. Our vision is to sequester gigatons of CO2 while regenerating soils. We value a culture of care and excellence, with a diverse, inclusive team primarily active in Brazil. Check our Glassdoor reviews and Culture page for more insights.

About the Role

Location: Brazil (São Paulo preferred)
Language Skills: Portuguese, English
Start Date: Q3/4 2025

We seek a strategic COO to lead go-to-market efforts and operational scaling. Responsibilities include overseeing the entire value chain, ensuring product-market fit, and scaling deployment from pilots to national impact. You will work closely with senior leaders and lead a team to ensure operational excellence and scientific integrity, fostering trust with farming partners and scaling our impact.

Key ResponsibilitiesStrategy, Innovation & Scaling Operations
  • Define and scale our carbon removal product from early traction to market leader.
  • Design and execute scalable ERW deployment operations in Brazil.
  • Translate climate goals into operational strategies.
  • Improve operations through KPIs and data-driven performance.
Agricultural & Supply Chain Leadership
  • Drive go-to-market strategies, building trust with stakeholders.
  • Develop partnerships with suppliers, logistics, and regional stakeholders.
  • Oversee sourcing, logistics, and deployment of rock powder.
  • Ensure compliance with standards and regulations.
Science-Driven Operations & Technology Alignment
  • Collaborate with science and tech teams to integrate R&D and data flows.
  • Ensure product efficacy and credibility in real-world deployment.
  • Support legal efforts for carbon reporting and impact.
Team & Culture Building
  • Build an entrepreneurial, accountable leadership culture.
  • Mentor and grow operations teams in Brazil and globally.
  • Promote a culture of collaboration and impact.
  • Empower regional managers and technical leads.
Ideal Candidate Profile

Core Skills & Experience

  • 10+ years in senior operations, supply chain, or agribusiness, especially in Brazil or high-growth/startup contexts.
  • Experience scaling from early-stage to market success, ideally as a founder, GM, or CEO.
  • Proven leadership of multidisciplinary teams and scalable systems.
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English.

Key Qualities

  • Visionary yet pragmatic, balancing strategy and urgency.
  • Confident, emotionally intelligent leadership.
  • Comfort with complexity, ambiguity, and rapid growth.
  • Hands-on, humble, willing to get involved physically when needed.
  • Passion for sustainability and climate innovation.

Bonus Points

  • Experience in impact sectors like climate or regenerative agriculture.
  • Deep network in Brazilian agriculture, logistics, or mining.
  • Experience building strategic partnerships in Brazil.
  • Experience developing and scaling agricultural tech.
Our Values
  • Trust: Promote transparency and kindness.
  • Drive: Take action with urgency and purpose.
  • Impact: Aim to make a meaningful global difference.
Benefits

  • Share options to foster ownership.

We ensure fair, equitable pay across regions, considering location, skills, and market conditions, with transparent ranges and adjustments to maintain competitiveness and fairness.

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

Help us shape the future of open source IT, devops, and IS, from bare metal to containers. Our goal is to revolutionise open source application and infrastructure operations.

We want to transform the world of software operations by enabling true model-driven operations via next-generation infrastructure-as-code. This will allow companies to run very efficient bare-metal operations for high-performance computing, private cloud, data lakes, AI/ML, and analytics. We need to invent some new technology, and we need to build some new products; we are therefore looking for someone who can lead and inspire a regional software engineering team to fulfill this initiative.

The Solutions Engineering team works in close collaboration with our managed infrastructure operations team, which runs many private OpenStack clouds and Kubernetes clusters for customers around the world. This enables us to improve our infra-as-code products based on our own real experience, mirroring that of our users and customers. We work in Python, creating open source automation capabilities that simplify operations for anybody, anywhere, who is building on Ubuntu.

Most of the team's work involves pure Python software development focused on enabling true DevOps workflows. We strive for high quality in both design, documentation, tests, and performance as we enhance operations code packages and Ubuntu itself in order to ensure our platform is the easiest, most robust, and best performing for driving your infrastructure.

This role is ideal for software engineers who want to work in a global team, have a passion for distributed systems and cloud computing, and an interest in the entire Linux stack - from kernel to networking to virtualization and containers.

What you will do

  • Work in Python and Golang to design and deliver open source software operations code
  • Work with the entire Linux stack, from kernel, networking, storage, to applications
  • Shape high quality open source monitoring and alerting infrastructure
  • Rethink open source operations for our customers and open source community
  • Demonstrate sound engineering design and testing principles in your code
  • Follow agile software development practices
  • Coach and develop your colleagues where you have insights
  • Grow a healthy, collaborative engineering culture in line with the company values
  • Global travel up to 10% of time for internal and external events

Who you are

  • You are a passionate Python developer
  • You are organised and want your team to deliver timely, high quality software
  • You understand the importance of reliable operations in an agile world
  • You have sound knowledge of cloud computing concepts & technologies
  • You have practical knowledge of Linux and networking
  • You are a lifelong learner

Bonus points for

  • You have graduated with a university degree in Computer Science or related software engineering field
  • Golang programming skills

What we offer colleagues

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

A Stone nasceu com o propósito de ser protagonista na transformação da indústria de pagamentos, lutando para oferecer as melhores soluções para quem empreende no Brasil.

Nossa Cultura

Own It: Ter espírito de dono te faz conquistar a liberdade. Valorizamos a autonomia e a proatividade, somos responsáveis pelo o que entregamos e queremos sempre evoluir o nosso negócio.

Live the Ride: Faça. Feito é melhor que perfeito. Aprendemos com os erros e encaramos desafios como oportunidades de aprendizado.

No Bullshit: Agir com simplicidade. Somos pessoas práticas, sinceras e gostamos de feedbacks. Sabemos que às vezes vamos errar e contamos com essa transparência para evoluirmos.

Team Play: Se quer ir rápido, vá sozinho(a). Se quer ir longe, trabalhe em equipe. É sempre possível aprender com as outras pessoas e a colaboração é a chave do sucesso.

The Reason: O cliente não tem razão, ele é a razão. Nos motivamos a enxergar o impacto do nosso trabalho na vida do cliente, é vendo que melhoramos a vida dele que sabemos que fizemos uma boa entrega.

Como é Ser Uma Pessoa Software Engineer Go Senior

Procuramos uma pessoa desenvolvedora apaixonada por desafios, tecnologia e conhecimento. Essa pessoa, junto ao time, será responsável por:

  • Atuar no desenvolvimento e manutenção de novas funcionalidades;

We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced IHV Alliance Sales Director to join our strategic partnerships team who will be responsible for leading IHV Alliances in the EMEA or APAC regions. Reporting to the Head of IHV Alliances, the IHV Alliance Sales Director will work closely with IHV and Canonical teams in those geographies to develop and maintain strong relationships with senior executives at strategic partner organizations, fostering collaboration and alignment on joint business objectives. Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

description:

Join to apply for the Crew Analyst – Talent Attraction role at Maersk Supply Service

At Maersk Supply Service, we believe that crewing is more than logistics—it’s about people. We’re looking for a Crew Analyst who shares our commitment to openness, collaboration, respect and to build a trustful relationship with all stakeholders, especially our offshore colleagues. If you’re someone who values transparent communication and wants to make a meaningful impact on the lives of our offshore colleagues, we’d love to hear from you.

Who are we?

At Maersk Supply Service (MSS), we’re more than a marine solutions provider—we’re a team of people who genuinely care about doing things right. Based in Rio de Janeiro, you’ll be welcomed into a close-knit HR & Crewing team that thrives on collaboration, open dialogue, and mutual respect. You’ll work alongside colleagues from across the organisation, each bringing their own expertise to help us navigate the complexities of the energy sector with integrity, safety, and purpose.

We enjoy what we do! We have a flexible and energized work environment. Here, ideas are not just heard—they’re valued. We celebrate our diverse backgrounds and see them as a true source of strength. We work close together, humbling listening and learning from each other, and overcoming challenges together, “we” should come before “I”. Every day, we strive to create a supportive space where your voice matters and your contributions lead to real change. This role is a unique blend of operational excellence and human connection.

As a company, we are owned by A.P. Moller Holding, operating independently with the trust and empowerment to do what is right for us, while proudly bearing the Maersk name and values.

What You Will Be Doing

The crewing department includes several HR subsystems, and as a Crew Analyst – Talent Attraction – you’ll play a key role in shaping the future of our MSS operations.

You’ll drive alignment on talent attraction strategies and process along with the Crew Manager, will execute the talent attraction process, and build a sustainable pool of skilled professionals by leading our cadet programme—supporting the growth and development of new seafarers and helping them thrive in their maritime careers.

Who You Are

First and foremost, you are passionate about the maritime industry, talent attraction and enjoy building up trusted relationships, and you recognize the game-changing potential by working in crewing and the positive effect that you can bring to people’s life. In addition, we hope you can say yes to the following:

  • Proficiency in verbal and written English and Portuguese.
  • Bachelor’s degree in psychology, Administration or related areas.
  • MBA in Human Resource is preferable for this position.
  • 3 years of previous experience in similar roles. Previous roles in the Maritime industry would be an advantage.
  • Has a strategic mindset and understands how talent drives business success.
  • Build strong networks and knows how to attract top talent through authentic engagement.
  • Communicates with clarity and impact—whether crafting employer branding or engaging with candidates.
  • Makes quality decisions quickly and confidently, even in fast-paced environments.
  • Champions diversity and inclusion, valuing different perspectives and backgrounds.
  • Is customer-focused, always thinking about the candidate experience.
  • Thrives on collaboration, influencing stakeholders and aligning hiring needs across teams.
  • Operational Excellence: Strong attention to detail in managing crew data, cost control, and vessel planning, ensuring smooth and compliant operations.
  • Process Improvement & Quality Focus: Proactive in identifying opportunities to enhance procedures and energise the team through continuous improvement.

How to Apply

If you can imagine yourself in this role, we look very much forward to hearing from you. Please apply through our website no later than 12 September 2025. We will review and interview on an ongoing basis, so please apply as soon as possible.

Company Description

Our Mission

At Palo Alto Networks® everything starts and ends with our mission:

Being the cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting our digital way of life.
Our vision is a world where each day is safer and more secure than the one before. We are a company built on the foundation of challenging and disrupting the way things are done, and we’re looking for innovators who are as committed to shaping the future of cybersecurity as we are.

Who We Are

This role is remote, but distance is no barrier to impact. Our hybrid teams collaborate across geographies to solve big problems, stay close to our customers, and grow together. You will be part of a culture that values trust, accountability, and shared success where your work truly matters.

Job Description

Your Career

You will join an exciting and high growth business unit with Palo Alto Networks positioning the industry’s most comprehensive SASE security platform, with the industry’s broadest security and compliance coverage for applications used by your hybrid workforce, regardless of whether they are at home, on the go, or in the office.

In this role, you will be responsible for managing a territory focusing on Major, Strategic, and Enterprise Accounts. Working closely with Palo Alto business partners and driving sales for our Enterprise Browser security solution, into new and existing customers. It is expected that you deliver or exceed your sales targets in both new business and renewals for ACV and TCV bookings. The role expects you to define your territory, strategies and then lead local execution and in alignment to company strategies and tactics within the Prisma SASE organization.

Your Impact

  • Win new logos, renew existing customer and expand business within your territory
  • Achieve ACV sales quotas on a monthly and quarterly basis
  • Present regular/accurate forecasting for review
  • Track and report on all opportunities, pipeline, and bookings to provide forecast reports to region management
  • Establish relationships and engage with the local reseller and alliance partners on sales programs and joint activities
  • Develop, share and implement standard methodologies and account strategies to increase our sales penetration of Enterprise Browser into our top accounts
  • Engage with customers to identify and progress opportunities whilst delivering subject matter expertise on Enterprise Browser solutions
  • Qualify and progress leads and opportunities through the sales cycle to closure
  • Keep up‑to‑date knowledge of Enterprise Browser and other browser technologies as well as the competitive position of the company
  • Conduct consistent training and communications for the sales and channel teams as well as joint engagement within the wider organization
  • Contribute to the larger Palo Alto Network’s Prisma SASE strategy by providing regional specific intelligence and reporting
  • Apply subject matter expertise in training, QBRs, enablement, and other engagement activities
  • Gather “Voice of Customer” and competitive intelligence and share with theater and global Prisma SASE organization
  • Help build and project Palo Alto Networks position
Qualifications

Your Experience

  • 4+ years' experience exceeding sales quota as Account Manager, or Territory Account Manager for a multinational company
  • Sales excellence - ability to demonstrate planning, strategy, qualification and execution
  • Prior experience selling SAAS or Cybersecurity network solutions
  • Existing relationships within the region, including top accounts and reseller partners
  • Excellent communication skills including strong verbal and written skills and proven presentation skills being able to articulate complex topics
  • Experience with target account selling, solution selling, and consultative sales techniques
Additional Information

The Team

Palo Alto Networks has brought technology to the market that is reshaping the cybersecurity threat and protection landscape. Our ability to protect digital transactions is limited only by our ability to establish relationships with our potential customers and help them understand how our products can protect their environments. This is where our sales teams come in. Our sales team members work together with large organizations to keep their digital information safe. Our passionate sales teams educate, inspire, and empower our potential clients.

As part of our sales team, you are empowered with unmatched systems and tools, constantly updated research and sales libraries, and a team built on joint success. You won’t find someone at Palo Alto Networks that isn’t committed to your success – with everyone pitching in to assist when it comes to solutions selling, learning, and development. As a member of our sales team, you are driven by a solutions-focused sales environment and find fulfillment in working with clients to resolve incredibly complex cyberthreats. You’re an amazing salesperson – you’re just looking for something more substantial and challenging as your next step.

Our Commitment

We’re problem solvers that take risks and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

ASPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma Associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrópica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e no município de sua sede, respectivamente pelos decretos nos. 57.925, de 04/03/1966, 40.103 de 17/05/1962 e 8.911, de 30/07/1970.

A Instituição atua nos âmbitos federal, estadual e municipal, em harmonia com suas políticas de saúde e de educação, e também como organização social habilitada em vários estados, na gerência de serviços e organizações de saúde, por meio de convênios e contratos de gestão.

A diretriz primordial da Associação é sua inserção no sistema de saúde direcionada ao tratamento, prevenção de doenças e à promoção da saúde primária, secundária e terciária, estreitando laços com a comunidade local e reafirmando seu compromisso social de atender a todos, sem discriminação.

Com o crescimento Institucional, a SPDM vem expandindo sua área de atuação com projetos, em desenvolvimento, na área da Assistência Social e na área Educacional. Toda essa gama de atividades consolida, cada vez mais, a SPDM como uma instituição filantrópica de grande porte, que busca a sustentabilidade econômica, social e ambiental.

Suas quatro superintendências - Hospital São Paulo, Instituições Afiliadas,Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde (PAIS) e Educação - são gerenciadas por profissionais de alta capacitação técnica e notável saber.

Assim, a SPDM contribui de forma efetiva para a melhoria contínua dos serviços prestados pelo Sistema Único de Saúde do Brasil, visando principalmente garantir a universalidade e as oportunidades de acesso à saúde, necessárias ao desenvolvimento humano e social do cidadão. Para tanto, associa o melhor da tecnologia com atendimento médico de alta qualidade, respaldado por equipes multiprofissionais, formadas por enfermeiros, fisioterapeutas, farmacêuticos, nutricionistas, fonoaudiólogos, bioquímicos, psicólogos, tecnólogos, assistentes sociais e dentistas, entre outros.

O Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde iniciou suas atividades no ano de 2001 no município de São Paulo, se estendendo para outros municípios e estados. Desde o início de suas atividades, oPAIS busca, em parceria com a gestão pública, o crescimento e a consolidação dos serviços de saúde ofertados aos usuários do SUS.

O Programa tem como objetivo garantir mudanças nos indicadores e na qualidade de vida da população, pautado, entre outros, pelos princípios da integralidade e da equidade, com uma visão estratégica da gestão dos serviços de saúde, definida em um processo de aprimoramento contínuo.

Inclusão

A SPDM oferece oportunidades de trabalho em suas unidades hospitalares, com plano de carreira, para pessoas com deficiência. Para tanto, periodicamente publica anúncio recrutando esses profissionais, nos principais jornais de São Paulo e dos municípios em que se localizam suas unidades.

Missão

Promover ações em saúde integradas com a gestão pública, em benefício da população de forma ética e humanizada, qualidade técnica, com compromisso social e ambiental.

Visão

Ser referência em gestão de serviços em saúde, abrangendo todos os níveis da assistência, garantindo atendimento com qualidade à população dos municípios e estados parceiros.

title: Sr. Growth Marketing Manager - Remote
description:
About Us

At Zyte, we eat data for breakfast and you can eat your breakfast anywhere and work for Zyte. Founded in 2010, we are a globally distributed team of over 250 Zytans working from over 28 countries who are on a mission to enable our customers to extract the data they need to continue to innovate and grow their businesses. We believe that all businesses deserve a smooth pathway to data. For more than a decade, Zyte has led the way in building powerful, easy-to-use tools to collect, format, and deliver web data, quickly, dependably, and at scale. And today, the data we extract helps thousands of organizations make smarter business decisions, secure competitive advantage, and drive sustainable growth. Today, over 3,000 companies and 1 million developers rely on our tools and services to get the data they need from the web.

Why You're Here

You’ll be the engine behind getting Zyte’s story and brand out into the world. Your mission is to turn content, of all types, into fuel for growth—promoting and repurposing Zyte.com content, distributing it across our ICP communities and marketing channels, and ensuring Zyte stays top‑of‑mind for developers, data teams and data buyers.

Responsibilities
  • Amplify and reinforce the Zyte brand as an authority in web scraping
  • Drive maximum reach and engagement for Zyte content
  • Reach our ICPs where they are, at scale
What You’ll Deliver
  • Content Amplification: Turn Zyte content into intelligent cross‑channel campaigns and ensure it reaches the right audiences
  • AI‑Powered Execution: Leverage AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, etc.) to repurpose content at scale
  • Channel Identification: Build presence in ecosystems like Reddit, Hackernews, Stack Overflow, LinkedIn, X, dev.to, substack, and emerging platforms (which you’ll need to identify)
  • Social Media & Community: Manage Zyte’s social presence with an eye for authenticity and cutting‑edge social plays
  • Campaign Velocity: Launch fast, iterative campaigns with tailored messaging per channel—no bloated briefs
Quantitative Metrics
  • New audience growth (traffic, reach, social engagement)
  • Content engagement (CTR, CVR, downloads, shares)
Qualitative Metrics
  • Innovation in AI‑driven content repurposing
  • Speed and creativity of campaign execution
  • Ability to crack web data professional ecosystems with authentic content
  • Cross‑team collaboration and impact on broader demand‑gen goals
Who You Are
  • Technical ICP‑Focused: You know what resonates with developers and data professionals—and what falls flat
  • Channel Fluent: You know how to break into niche ecosystems with the right tone, content, and delivery
  • AI‑Native: You use AI as a natural part of your workflow, not an afterthought. We need to see this in your mentality.
  • Campaign Writing Aficionado: You know what it takes to take a great piece of content and ensure our target audiences see it and appreciate it. This includes the ability to repurpose, identify alternative formats (video, infographics, podcast episode, etc.), and amplify the core messages
  • Fast‑Moving: You value execution speed and iteration over perfect briefs
Requirements
  • 5+ years B2B SaaS marketing, ideally with developer or technical products
  • Strong copywriting + AI‑assisted content skills
  • Track record of fast, iterative campaign launches across channels, with a strong working knowledge of channel nuances
  • (BONUS) Familiarity with web scraping, data extraction, or developer tools
Tech You’ll Work With
  • HubSpot, Microsoft Clarity, Google Analytics
  • Figma, Notion, Google Workspace
  • ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and other LLMs for message generation and ideation
How We Work

We move fast, learn loud, and optimize often. Campaigns are built around business goals—not bloated processes. You’ll have the autonomy to test, iterate, and scale ideas that work.

Benefits
  • Become part of a self‑motivated, progressive, multi‑cultural team
  • Have the freedom and flexibility to work from where you do your best work
  • Attend conferences and meet with team members from across the globe
  • Work with cutting‑edge open source technologies and tools

Own It: Ter espírito de dono te faz conquistar a liberdade. Valorizamos a autonomia e a proatividade, somos responsáveis pelo o que entregamos e queremos sempre evoluir o nosso negócio.

Live the Ride: Faça. Feito é melhor que perfeito. Aprendemos com os erros e encaramos desafios como oportunidades de aprendizado.

No Bullshit: Agir com simplicidade. Somos pessoas práticas, sinceras e gostamos de feedbacks. Sabemos que às vezes vamos errar e contamos com essa transparência para evoluirmos.

Team Play: Se quer ir rápido, vá sozinho(a). Se quer ir longe, trabalhe em equipe. É sempre possível aprender com as outras pessoas e a colaboração é a chave do sucesso.

The Reason: O cliente não tem razão, ele é a razão. Queremos gerar impacto para nosso(a) cliente, quando enxergamos a melhoria que causamos na vida dele(a), é que sabemos que fizemos uma boa entrega.

Nossa missão é garantir o melhor e mais rápido atendimento do país. Conhecido como Hunter Angels, esse time tem a missão de reduzir a quantidade de perdas de máquinas e aumentar a eficiência da cadeia logística, gerando rentabilidade para a companhia.

Para isso, a sua rotina é realizar atendimento ativo aos clientes por meio de telefone e, quando necessário, em múltiplos canais para recuperação dos terminais (maquininhas) que estão em clientes inativos.

title: Supervisor de Cozinha (Com Experiência)
description:
QUEM SOMOS
Somos uma rede de hostels no Rio de Janeiro com 20 anos de experiência no mercado.

EMPRESA
El Misti Hostels

LOCALIZAÇÃO
Ipanema, Rio de Janeiro/RJ

CONTRATO
CLT (Efetivo)

DESCRIÇÃO

Gestão Operacional:
Supervisionar a preparação e o serviço de alimentos, garantindo o cumprimento de padrões de qualidade e segurança alimentar. Planejar e organizar a rotina da cozinha, incluindo horários de produção e operação.
Monitorar o tempo de produção e garantir que os prazos sejam cumpridos.

Liderança de Equipe:
Liderar e treinar a equipe de cozinheiros, distribuindo tarefas e monitorando a performance. Coordenar escalas de trabalho, garantindo que a equipe esteja adequada às demandas do serviço. Resolver conflitos e promover um ambiente de trabalho colaborativo.

Controle de Estoque e Pedidos:
Controlar o estoque de ingredientes, verificar a necessidade de reposição e fazer pedidos de insumos. Gerenciar o armazenamento adequado dos alimentos e o controle de desperdício.
Realizar inventários periódicos e garantir a utilização eficiente dos produtos.

Garantia de Padrões de Higiene e Segurança:
Assegurar o cumprimento das normas de higiene e segurança alimentar em todas as etapas da produção.
Realizar inspeções periódicas e corrigir possíveis desvios nos procedimentos de limpeza e manipulação de alimentos.

Desenvolvimento e Aperfeiçoamento de Cardápios:
Colaborar no desenvolvimento de novos pratos e na melhoria do cardápio, considerando custos, qualidade e tendências. Ajustar o cardápio conforme feedback dos clientes e da equipe, mantendo a inovação e a diversidade nas opções oferecidas.

Controle Financeiro:
Gerenciar o custo dos alimentos, mantendo a operação dentro do orçamento estabelecido. Analisar relatórios de custos e desperdícios, sugerindo melhorias para otimização de recursos.

Manutenção de Equipamentos:
Monitorar o uso adequado dos equipamentos de cozinha e solicitar manutenções ou substituições quando necessário. Garantir a correta limpeza e conservação dos utensílios e maquinários.

Apoio ao Atendimento:
Trabalhar em parceria com a equipe de atendimento para garantir que os pratos sejam servidos corretamente e dentro dos padrões exigidos. Resolver problemas relacionados a pedidos de clientes e adaptar a produção quando necessário.

Horário de trabalho:

  • Turno de 8 horas

REMUNERAÇÃO
R$2092.- Mais Comissões.

BENEFÍCIOS

  • Vale Transporte
  • Vale Alimentação

Join to apply for the Ubuntu Core Software Engineer role at Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

We are hiring a Ubuntu Core Software Engineer to redefine the Linux experience in the embedded environments with the smallest, most secure, and updatable operating system in the IoT market. This is an opportunity for a software engineer passionate about open source software, Linux, security, and the developer experience. This challenging role demands a high degree of technical skill with low-level operating systems, kernel, and device firmware.

Our mission is to allow everyone to build robust solutions in various fields including but not limited to IoT, automotive, and aviation using the next generation secure embedded Linux operating system in a simple solution. We define a reliable and secure set of device recovery mechanisms that enable device manufacturers to simplify and standardise the field operations for fleets of heterogeneous appliances.

As an Ubuntu Core team member, you'll be designing and implementing software that runs on various CPU architectures, such as ARM, RISC-V, and X86. You will work on boot mechanisms, bootloaders, storage partition layout, device trees, kernel and services.

Build a rewarding, meaningful career working with the best and brightest people in technology at Canonical, a growing international software company.

Location : This role will be based remotely in the EMEA region

The role entails

  • Write high quality code with unit tests to create new features
  • Debug Linux system level issues and produce high quality code to fix them
  • Collaborate proactively with a distributed team
  • Review code produced by other engineers
  • Discuss ideas and collaborate on finding good solutions
  • Integrate diverse bootloaders and maintain gadget snaps
  • Work from home with global travel 2 to 4 times a year for internal and external events

What we are looking for in you

  • You love technology and working with brilliant people
  • You are curious, flexible, articulate, and accountable
  • You value soft skills and are passionate, enterprising, thoughtful, and self-motivated
  • You have a Bachelor's or equivalent in Computer Science, STEM or similar degree
  • You have experience with C or Golang, and Shell
  • You have a solid understanding of Linux and a modern GNU/Linux distribution, Debian or Ubuntu preferred
  • You have personal or professional experience with Linux-capable devices such as Raspberry Pi
  • You have interest in learning or experience in one or more low-level systems and security facilities such as:
  • Bootloaders in ARM and X86, such as piboot, uboot, grub-uefi
  • Systemd and units, udev, initrd, graphics
  • OS level firmware daemons and CLI applications
  • Linux security implementations - TPM, FDE, LUKS, HSM, etc.
You may have experience or knowledge of Yocto
What we offer colleagues

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

  • Impeccable ethics and trustworthiness.

Na MCS Markup todas as oportunidades são aderentes à diversidade e abertas a pessoas com deficiência! Valorizamos a singularidade de cada indivíduo e acreditamos que a inclusão enriquece nosso ambiente de trabalho.

Se você busca um espaço onde suas habilidades e potencial sejam reconhecidos, esta é a sua chance! Venha fazer parte de uma equipe que preza pela diversidade e pela igualdade.

Sobre a vaga:

Buscamos Consultor TAX, para atuar em nosso time na área tributária, no Rio de Janeiro e em São Paulo.

O Consultor TAX da MCS Markup atua na assessoria e consultoria a empresas em questões relacionadas à legislação tributária, buscando garantir a conformidade e eficiência nas operações fiscais. Esse profissional orienta os clientes sobre a melhor forma de cumprir suas obrigações fiscais, enquanto aproveita incentivos e benefícios disponíveis, além de minimizar riscos tributários.

Requisitos e qualificações

O que esperamos de você para essa vaga:

  • Graduação concluída em Direito ou Ciências Contábeis;
  • Conhecimento no pacote office, com ênfase em Excel;
  • Experiência prévia em consultorias tributária e/ou Big4;
  • Vivência na área de tributos diretos e indiretos.

Principais Atividades:

  • Revisar e apurar tributos diretos (IRPJ, CSLL) e indiretos (PIS, COFINS, ICMS, IPI, ISS).
  • Elaborar e validar obrigações acessórias (ECD, ECF, DCTF, PER/DCOMP, SPED Fiscal, SPED Contribuições, entre outras).
  • Analisar e revisar retenções na fonte de tributos federais e municipais.
  • Apoiar no planejamento tributário e na identificação de oportunidades de economia fiscal.
  • Realizar análises de classificação fiscal e correta aplicação de benefícios/regimes especiais.
  • Acompanhar alterações na legislação e elaborar pareceres técnicos sobre impactos tributários.
  • Participar de fiscalizações e auditorias, fornecendo suporte técnico e documentações necessárias.
  • Apoiar em projetos de recuperação de créditos tributários e otimização de processos fiscais.
  • Elaborar relatórios gerenciais e apresentações de resultados para clientes ou áreas internas.

O que oferecemos:

Contratação CLT;

Assistência Médica e Odontológica;

Seguro de Vida;

VR/VA;

Vale Transporte;

Wellhub (Gympass);

Parcerias em Instituições de Ensino e idiomas;

Plataforma de Gestão de Saúde Emocional;

Day off no seu aniversário;

Universidade Corporativa.

Etapas do processo:

Inscrição: Inicie sua jornada conosco realizando seu cadastro. Fique tranquilo(a), nossa equipe irá analisar as informações do seu perfil e entrará em contato em breve.

Entrevista com Recursos Humanos: Você terá a oportunidade de dialogar com nosso time de Atração de Talentos; Seleção. O objetivo é nos conhecermos melhor e garantir que nossos valores e abordagens estejam alinhados com suas crenças e expectativas.

Entrevista com a Liderança: Nesta fase, mergulharemos no seu conhecimento técnico para avaliar as habilidades e competências essenciais para a posição.

Retorno do processo: Independentemente do resultado, iremos comunicá-lo a você e discutir os próximos passos.

title: Projetista de Tubulação III
description:
Sobre a vaga:

O Projetista de Tubulação será responsável pela modelagem, detalhamento e desenvolvimento de projetos de sistemas de tubulação aplicados a embarcações, plataformas e estruturas offshore. Esse profissional terá papel essencial na elaboração de desenhos técnicos, isométricos e listas de materiais, assegurando que todas as soluções estejam alinhadas com os requisitos técnicos, operacionais e regulatórios da indústria naval e offshore.

Rotina de trabalho:

Trabalhar na Proper Marine é integrar uma equipe multidisciplinar altamente qualificada, com foco em excelência técnica, inovação e segurança. Nosso ambiente estimula a troca de conhecimento, o desenvolvimento contínuo e a entrega de soluções eficientes, com espaço para autonomia, criatividade e crescimento profissional.

Formação e experiência:

  • Curso Técnico completo em Projetos Mecânicos, Tubulação, Mecânica, Engenharia Naval ou áreas afins.

  • Desejável formação complementar em Engenharia ou cursos de especialização em tubulação industrial/naval.

  • Registro no CREA (para técnicos ou tecnólogos).

  • Experiência mínima de 5 anos atuando como projetista de tubulação em ambientes navais, offshore ou óleo & gás.

  • Vivência com projetos de sistemas complexos de tubulação a bordo de FPSOs, embarcações de apoio marítimo, sondas, plataformas fixas ou módulos industriais.

Principais responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Desenvolver e revisar modelos 3D de tubulação usando ferramentas específicas (AutoCAD Plant 3D, E3D, PDMS, Navisworks).

  • Elaborar isométricos, desenhos ortogonais, layouts e listas de materiais (BOM/MTO).

  • Realizar roteamento de linhas considerando espaço, interferências, suporte, manutenção e acessibilidade.

  • Participar de revisões de projeto (model review) com equipes multidisciplinares, propondo soluções de engenharia.

  • Garantir que os desenhos estejam em conformidade com os P&IDs, normas de classe e diretrizes do projeto.

  • Verificar interferências e colisões (clash detection) junto às disciplinas de estrutura, elétrica e instrumentação.

  • Preparar documentação técnica de apoio à fabricação e montagem.

  • Colaborar com engenheiros e coordenadores de projeto na definição de especificações e padrões técnicos.

  • Apoiar na compatibilização de disciplinas e interface com fornecedores e estaleiros quando necessário.

Habilidades Técnicas (Hard Skills):

  • Domínio em ferramentas de modelagem e detalhamento de tubulação:

  • AutoCAD Plant 3D, E3D, PDMS, Navisworks, SmartPlant ou equivalentes.

  • Leitura e interpretação de diagramas de processo (P&ID), fluxogramas, plantas e cortes.

  • Conhecimento em:

  • Materiais e classes de tubulação (carbono, inox, duplex, cobre-níquel etc.)

  • Componentes de sistemas de tubulação: válvulas, flanges, suportes, juntas de expansão, etc.

  • Normas e códigos aplicáveis: ASME B31.3 / B31.1, API, NORSOK, ISO, NR-13, entre outros.

  • Noções de cálculo de suportação e esforço, embora não seja um cargo de engenharia.

  • Experiência com sistemas típicos de embarcações e offshore, como:

  • Sistemas de lastro, incêndio, ar-condicionado, combustível, ar comprimido, água potável e esgoto.

  • Familiaridade com práticas de projeto naval, requisitos de classe (DNV, ABS, BV).

  • Inglês técnico para leitura de normas, especificações e comunicação com equipes globais.

Habilidades Comportamentais (Soft Skills):

  • Atenção aos detalhes: compromisso com qualidade, precisão e conformidade técnica.

  • Organização: capacidade de gerenciar múltiplos entregáveis com eficiência.

  • Comunicação clara: para dialogar com equipes internas, engenheiros, fornecedores e estaleiros.

  • Trabalho em equipe: colaboração ativa com diferentes disciplinas.

  • Proatividade: iniciativa para propor melhorias técnicas e identificar possíveis inconsistências de projeto.

  • Flexibilidade e adaptabilidade: agilidade para lidar com alterações de escopo e prazos apertados.

  • Comprometimento com prazos e excelência técnica.

Se você tem experiência sólida em projetos de tubulação naval e quer atuar em uma empresa global com foco em engenharia de ponta, segurança e inovação, essa vaga é para você!

This is a senior role where bold strategy meets operational precision to drive transformational scale.

This is a rare opportunity to refine product-market fit , identify scalable customer use cases, lead the integration of field deployment, scientific integrity, and operational scaling in one of the world’s most promising carbon removal approaches. On the operational front, you will work closely with our Chief Impact Officer and Head of Operations , who leads the charge on regional management, farmer acquisition, and the logistical execution of rock powder spreading across Brazil. You’ll work hand-in-hand with our VP of Science , ensuring that our field strategy is aligned with our scientific standards, operational goals, and long-term climate impact targets - building a delivery system that is not only efficient, but deeply trusted by our farming partners.

As a core strategic and visionary player, you’ll work cross-functionally to ensure our product offering is differentiated and delivers real agronomic value while meeting carbon certification requirements. You’ll be responsible for orchestrating our 1-100 scale-up journey : evolving early pilots into robust, repeatable, and high-impact operations at national scale.

We’re at a tipping point of scale, with growing complexity across teams, partners, and international ecosystems. The ideal candidate has a strong operational track record , ideally in Brazilian agribusiness , and can bridge execution with innovation.

You will report directly to the CEO and be a critical member of our Senior Leadership Team alongside our CFO. You’ll directly lead a large and growing team, including:

  • Head of Operations and all project deployment teams including Supply and Regional Managers
  • Our Science team, in close partnership with the VP of Science
  • Collaboration with Carbon, and Technology teams
  • Strategic collaboration with our Chief Impact Officer, and commercial partners

You’ll play a central role in aligning science, fieldwork, and operations , ensuring we stay ahead in the rapidly evolving climate and carbon removal landscape.

Key Responsibilities

Strategy, Innovation & Scaling Operations

  • You’ll help define and scale a novel carbon removal product - taking it from early traction to being a key player in agriculture and mining. This is a 1-100 leadership role, demanding bold strategy, deep market insight, and relentless execution.
  • Lead the design and execution of a world-class ERW deployment operation across Brazil, with scalability in mind.
  • Translate InPlanet’s carbon and climate goals into clear operational strategies and regional delivery models.
  • Drive continuous improvement through operational KPIs, systemisation, and performance data.

Agricultural & Supply Chain Leadership

  • You’ll drive go-to-market strategies that bring breakthrough mineral products into entrenched agricultural systems, building the trust and partnerships needed for national adoption. Commercial creativity and strategic grit will be essential.
  • Build strategic partnerships with input suppliers, logistics providers, agricultural service firms, and regional stakeholders.
  • Oversee the sourcing, logistics, and deployment of rock powder - from mine to farm.
  • Ensure operational excellence and compliance with carbon standards, farmer requirements, and regulatory frameworks.

Science-Driven Operations & Technology Alignment

  • Collaborate with Science, Carbon, and Technology teams to ensure smooth integration of R&D, field trials, and data flows.
  • You’ll bridge science and market, ensuring our product not only works in trials but wins in the real world. Field feedback will shape product evolution and create operational systems that scale with credibility and speed.
  • Support the legal team to uphold integrity in carbon reporting and environmental impact.

Team & Culture Building

  • You’ll build a leadership culture that’s entrepreneurial, fast, and accountable - turning high performers into high-impact owners. Your teams will know not just what to do, but why it matters.
  • Lead, mentor, and grow high-performing operations teams across Brazil and globally.
  • Champion a culture of accountability, collaboration, and impact-driven execution.
  • Empower regional managers and technical leads to deliver quality projects at scale.

You can be a Rock-Star if you have

Core Skills & Experience

  • 10+ years of senior leadership in operations, supply chain, or agribusiness in Brazil and in high-growth or startup contexts.
  • You’ve scaled something from messy beginnings to market success - ideally as a founder, GM, or CEO. You know what product-market fit looks like, and how to turn it into category leadership.
  • Proven experience leading multidisciplinary teams and building scalable systems from the ground up.
  • Strong communication and negotiation skills in Portuguese and English.

Key Qualities

  • Visionary but pragmatic - able to balance long-term strategy with daily urgency.
  • A confident, emotionally intelligent leader who knows when to listen, act, and delegate.
  • Comfortable navigating complexity, ambiguity, and rapid growth.
  • Hands-on, humble, and willing to “get your boots dirty” when needed.
  • Passion for sustainability, tropical agriculture, and climate innovation.

Bonus Points

  • Experience in impact-driven sectors such as climate, carbon markets, or regenerative agriculture is a big plus.
  • Deep knowledge and network of Brazilian agriculture, logistics, or mining.
  • Experience building strategic and commercial partnerships in Brazil, within agriculture.
  • Experience with building and scaling tech for agriculture.

Living Our Values

At InPlanet, we have a big vision of solving climate change, and we are looking for individuals who are genuinely passionate about making a positive difference in the world of Carbon Removal Solutions. Trust guides our actions, drive fuels our efforts, and impact is our goal.

  • Trust: You believe in being kind and transparent in the workplace, fostering an environment where trust thrives and collaboration flourishes
  • Drive: You possess an innate drive to take action with a hands-on, can-do attitude, propelled by urgency
  • Impact: You dream big and are committed to making a meaningful difference in the world, aligning with our overarching mission to address climate change

Application Process

  • Interview with VP of People

  • 1-2 more 1:1 interviews with core leaders
  • Panel with 4+ team members (specific task, preparation needed)

How To Apply

Industries & Environment - Possibilitando infraestrutura, transporte e indústrias mais seguras, sustentáveis e ecológicas. Os clientes precisam saber que os alimentos que ingerem, os medicamentos, os produtos cosméticos e de higiene que utilizam são seguros e não os prejudicam. Na SGS, oferecemos a mais ampla gama de soluções de teste, inspeção e certificação para as indústrias de ciência agrícola, alimentos, ciências da saúde e cosméticos e higiene.

Natural Resources – Possibilitando eficiência e sustentabilidade nas indústrias agrícola, de mineração, petróleo, gás e química. Os recursos naturais são essenciais para o desenvolvimento econômico e fundamentais para a vida cotidiana. Nossa rede global de especialistas oferece suporte com terceirização de laboratório, logística de commodities, geoquímica, metalurgia, sustentabilidade e soluções de inteligência de mercado para ajudar a reduzir riscos, tomar decisões informadas e garantir a integridade.

title: Automation Engineer, Electrical
description:
MacGregor is a global company that operates in 30 countries with 2000 employees. We provide sustainable cargo and load handling with a strong portfolio of products, services, and solutions to the maritime and offshore industries. Our solutions are found in over half of the world's merchant fleet.

We believe MacGregor is a great place to work and we are looking for innovators with an international mindset to join our team and help us create lifetime value for our customers.

MacGregor – Let's shape the future together

Are you driven by problem solving? Do you thrive working with complex and large equipment? Look no further, MacGregor is looking to hire an Automation Engineer, Electrical.

The purpose of this role is to execute service, repair, and maintenance work, including diagnostics, troubleshooting, and repair of advanced hydraulic and mechanical equipment, as well as electrical and control systems, across the MacGregor product range and third-party products, if needed.

This is a position that requires that you travel to client sites, vessels or at shipyards worldwide. Our clients are primarily domestic but also spread across the globe, i.e., the US, South and Central America, and beyond. Therefore, flexibility and a strong willingness to travel is essential. Our office and workshop is located in the Rio de Janeiro area where you might be assigned to local work if needed, therefore it is essential that you live within reach.

More tasks and responsibilities
  • Provide information and write reports as required
  • Supervise and perform service activities such as refurbishment, upgrades, inspections, preventative maintenance and corrective actions
  • Stay up to date with relevant developments, routines, processes and news
  • Comply with all relevant safety and quality requirements according to the company standards.

This role is part of our Global Services Division. Reporting directly to the Operations Superintendent.

What you’ll need to succeed

Your main discipline is automation and software. As a person you are customer-oriented, cooperative, and have good communication skills, with the ability to effectively share information within the team.

  • At least 5 years working directly with software and automation;
  • Education within the electrical, control and automation field. Relevant experience may compensate for lack of education;
  • Previous experience in the maritime/shipping industry and with shipboard equipment (cranes) is essential.

description:
Banco de Talentos (Técnico de Segurança do Trabalho)

Descrição da vaga

Acompanhar e/ou implementar os programas de segurança, proteção e meio ambiente, seguindo ou produzindo os seguintes processos: PPRA, CIPA, CAT, DDS e etc., fiscalizando e acompanhando o uso dos EPI´s, controlando a data de expiração dos equipamentos e materiais, elaborando relatórios fotográficos, além de palestras e integrações de novos funcionários.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Distribuir diariamente aos colaboradores os EPI`s que serão usados, recolhendo aqueles danificados e separando-os, anotando na ficha pessoal de cada colaborador o que foi retirado e qual a data do trâmite, para fins de enviar uma notificação ao Auxiliar Administrativo para posterior compra, cumprimento da legislação e preservação da integridade física do colaborador.
  • Fazer levantamento diário do estoque de todo o material de segurança do trabalho (entradas e saídas), anotando em planilha manual a relação dos materiais que faltam, repassando ao Administrativo, para fins de reposição de estoque.
  • Visitar diariamente as áreas operacionais, para fins de inspecionar a segurança nas áreas.
  • Fazer vistoria de veículos mensalmente, verificando pessoalmente os freios, faróis e etc., informando aos Terceirizados caso haja necessidade de algum reparo, lançando em planilha feita no Word os problemas relacionados ao veículo e enviando ao Gerente de Filial os problemas encontrados, para fins de manter os veículos em boas condições e segurança dos colaboradores.
  • Fazer análise de risco baseando-se nas atividades que serão feitas pelas equipes, definindo qual será o EPI usado, qual o processo mais seguro para a realização da atividade, enumerando os possíveis riscos, para fins de preservar a integridade física dos colaboradores.
  • Fazer diariamente a inspeção de segurança, especificando as não conformidades existentes nos locais, fazendo um relatório e encaminhando ao Gerente de Filial ou à empresa responsável, para fins de preservar a integridade física do colaborador e do Meio Ambiente.
  • Responsável por elaborar todo trâmite relacionado à eleição da CIPA e os documentos da mesma, exigidos pelo Ministério do Trabalho e Emprego, para fins de atender a fiscalização trabalhista.
  • Fazer cumprir as ações da CIPA em acordo com o SMS, identificar necessidades, planejar, executar e avaliar programas de treinamento de segurança industrial e meio ambiente.
  • Controlar mensalmente o SESMT, número de acidentes ocorridos em cada setor, através de notificação do ocorrido, reunindo as CATS, análise de levantamento de acidentes, fazendo um parâmetro e calculando as horas perdidas, total de cada setor, enviando as cópias ao Gerente de Filial e a empresa CSN, para fins de controle do número de acidentes e as horas perdidas.
  • Notificar eventualmente, através de comunicado feito em planilha Excel, uma análise do acidente ocorrido através de simulações ou depoimentos, traçando medidas corretivas, enviando ao Supervisor de área em que ocorreu o acidente, para fins de prevenir acidentes com a mesma proporção.
  • Preencher eventualmente no site do INSS, uma CAT no prazo máximo de quarenta e oito horas após o acidente, informando a lesão ocorrida, o local e a hora, o agente causador, a situação causadora, imprimindo uma cópia e arquivando, fornecendo cópia ao colaborador, e enviando através do site do INSS, para fins de comunicar ao INSS, preservar o colaborador de possíveis dificuldades trabalhistas e a empresa de possíveis processos trabalhistas.
  • Coordenar eventualmente a troca ou efetiva recarga de extintores, inspecionando um a um, mantendo contato direto com a empresa responsável pela manutenção dos extintores para fins da Triunfo estar preparada caso ocorra algum incêndio.
  • Promover eventualmente a integração dos novos colaboradores, apresentando os riscos a que estão expostos, ensinando os procedimentos e análises de riscos, fazendo um treinamento total dos mesmos, apresentação através de Power Point, dando palestras em sala de reuniões, apresentando-os aos seus Supervisores, para fins de mostrar os riscos aos novos colaboradores, apresentar-lhes as responsabilidades e obrigações dentro da empresa.
  • Elaborar mensalmente no Word, gerando cópias e distribuindo em locais de livre acesso aos colaboradores um jornal interno, imputando informações preventivas e atualidades, para fins de fornecer informações e gerar uma integração.
  • Fiscalizar diariamente as Unidades, com o intuito de assegurar que o DDS (Diálogo Diário de Segurança) está sendo cumprido, arquivando e assinando o DDS, para fins de promover a conscientização e prevenção de acidentes entre os colaboradores.
  • Preencher eventualmente uma planilha enviada pelo Porto de Itaguaí, constando a entrada e saída de resíduos da oficina, entregando ao Chefe de Oficina, que é responsável pelo recolhimento, para fins de conformidades junto à FEEMA.
  • Representar eventualmente a empresa na CPATP (Comissão de Prevenção de Acidentes de Trabalhadores Portuários), participando de reuniões ordinárias e semestrais para fins de justificar problemas e tomar as devidas providências.
  • Planejar, coordenar, orientar tecnicamente, avaliar e realizar estudos, avaliações e inspeções das condições de trabalho, quanto aos aspectos de higiene industrial, segurança industrial e meio ambiente, em áreas, equipamentos, instalações.
  • Elaborar documentação necessária para a abertura da Comunicação de Acidente de Trabalho e encaminhar para o Setor de Recursos Humanos para que a mesma seja emitida.
  • Orientar os membros da CIPA para os assuntos ligados a saúde e higiene, através da participação em reuniões e da realização de palestras na semana de prevenção da empresa, visando prevenir doenças e acidentes do trabalho.
  • Indicar e orientar a implementação de medidas preventivas de segurança em toda área industrial, administrativa e proteção ao meio ambiente.
  • Fazer cumprir as ações da CIPA em acordo com o SMS, identificar necessidades, planejar, executar e avaliar programas de treinamento de segurança industrial e meio ambiente.
  • Fazer plano de ação para cumprimento do Anexo SMS escopo do Contrato, apresentando evidências para PETROBRAS.
  • Participar de programas de auditorias de SMS, segurança industrial e de meio ambiente, acompanhar as atividades operacionais nas áreas contratuais, visando à segurança do profissional envolvido, bem patrimonial e meio ambiente.
  • Investigar e analisar acidentes e ocorrências anormais, planejando e executando Plano de Ação trazendo segurança nas operações.
  • Elaborar planos de contingência e coordenar atividades de controle de emergências para todas as áreas contratuais, proceder de acordo com os padrões técnicos e normas operacionais.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Formação técnica em Segurança do Trabalho
  • Registro no MTE
  • Conhecimento em legislação de segurança do trabalho e normas regulamentadoras (NR)
  • Bons conhecimentos em informática e ferramentas de gestão
  • Habilidade de comunicação e interação com equipes

Benefícios

  • Convênio Farmácia: desconto em medicamentos e produtos diversos para higiene pessoal
  • Alimentação no local
  • GymPass / Seguro de Vida
  • Descontos em instituições de ensino parceiras

Sobre a empresa

A Triunfo Logística oferece soluções competitivas de operação portuária e logística de acordo com os mais elevados padrões de qualidade e segurança, respeito ao indivíduo e ao meio ambiente, agregando máximo valor aos acionistas e à sociedade de forma ética e inovadora.

  • Availability to go to rig site as required.

  • Fluent in English language both Writing & Spoken.

  • Specific Skills required: Well Cat, PROSPER / Wellflo / Olga, BASIC Well Test Interpretation, Flow Assurance.

title: MÉDICO PSIQUIATRA - CEEDI AP 3.3
description:
Job description

SPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma Associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrópica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e no município de sua sede, respectivamente pelos decretos nos. 57.925, de 04/03/1966, 40.103 de 17/05/1962 e 8.911, de 30/07/1970.

A Instituição atua nos âmbitos federal, estadual e municipal, em harmonia com suas políticas de saúde e de educação, e também como organização social habilitada em vários estados, na gerência de serviços e organizações de saúde, por meio de convênios e contratos de gestão.

A diretriz primordial da Associação é sua inserção no sistema de saúde direcionada ao tratamento, prevenção de doenças e à promoção da saúde primária, secundária e terciária, estreitando laços com a comunidade local e reafirmando seu compromisso social de atender a todos, sem discriminação.

Com o crescimento Institucional, a SPDM vem expandindo sua área de atuação com projetos, em desenvolvimento, na área da Assistência Social e na área Educacional. Toda essa gama de atividades consolida, cada vez mais, a SPDM como uma instituição filantrópica de grande porte, que busca a sustentabilidade econômica, social e ambiental.

Suas quatro superintendências - Hospital São Paulo, Instituições Afiliadas, Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde (PAIS) e Educação - são gerenciadas por profissionais de alta capacitação técnica e notável saber.

Main responsibilities

Centro Especializado de Estímulo ao Desenvolvimento Infantil - Reabilitação Intelectual e TEA (CEEDI) é um serviço cuja proposta é rever e transformar a lógica do capacitismo e oportunizar o diagnóstico qualificado em tempo oportuno, por meio de um modelo de serviço que incorpore a avaliação especializada para o diagnóstico diferencial, estimulação precoce, com equipe multidisciplinar para processo de re/habilitação, envolvendo a rede de apoio no processo e projeto terapêutico.

Trata-se de um centro de reabilitação, modalidade reabilitação intelectual, com ações e serviços voltados para avaliar, desenvolver ou ampliar a capacidade funcional para o desenvolvimento pleno das crianças e adolescentes com deficiência intelectual, transtornos globais de desenvolvimento, transtorno do espectro autista, investindo em iniciativas que trabalhem potencialidades, talentos, habilidades e aptidões físicas, cognitivas, sensoriais, psicossociais, atitudinais, profissionais e artísticas, para a autonomia e participação cidadã em igualdade de condições e oportunidades com as demais pessoas. A habilitação/reabilitação prevê uma abordagem interdisciplinar e o envolvimento direto de profissionais, cuidadores e familiares/ parceiros nos processos de cuidado.

O profissional, terá a função de realizar o seguimento das crianças com alterações nos marcos do desenvolvimento, contemplando a avaliação longitudinal com o objetivo de elucidação diagnóstica, início precoce da estimulação precoce e orientação dos familiares e responsáveis.

Requirements and skills
  • Ensino Superior Completo em Medicina com registro ativo no Conselho da Classe
  • Registro de especialista em Psiquiatria (RQE)
  • Desejável pós-graduação em uma ou mais das áreas citadas a seguir: Saúde Mental; TEA; Saúde da Família; Saúde Pública; Saúde Coletiva
  • Registro ativo no Conselho da Classe
  • Desejável experiência com TEA (Transtorno do Espectro Autista na infância e adolescência)
Additional information
  • Carga Horária: 40h/20h semanais
  • Local de atuação: AP 3.3 (Madureira e Adjacências)

RINA is currently recruiting for a Senior Asset Integrity RBI Engineer to join its office in Rio de Janeiro within theOperations and Maintenance Engineering Division.

Mission

The Senior Asset Integrity RBI Engineer plays a pivotal role in optimizing inspection strategies within the Oil & Gas facilities or power plant by implementing risk-based inspection methodologies. Their mission is to assess the integrity of equipment and facilities, prioritize inspection activities based on risk assessment, and develop cost-effective inspection plans to ensure asset reliability, safety, and regulatory compliance. #LI-KM

Key Accountabilities

Risk Assessment and Analysis:

  • Conduct risk assessments of equipment and infrastructure using RBI methodologies.
  • Identify and evaluate potential failure modes, consequences, and likelihood of failure.
  • Analyze risk data to prioritize inspection activities according to risk levels.

Inspection Planning and Optimization:

  • Develop risk-based inspection plans tailored to specific equipment and process units.
  • Determine appropriate inspection techniques, frequencies, and inspection intervals based on risk assessment results.
  • Optimize inspection schedules to minimize downtime and maximize asset integrity.

Data Management and Documentation:

  • Maintain comprehensive records of inspection data, risk assessments, and inspection plans.
  • Utilize software tools and databases to manage RBI data and documentation effectively.
  • Ensure accuracy, completeness, and integrity of RBI data for informed decision-making.

Continuous Improvement and Compliance:

  • Identify opportunities for optimization and improvement of RBI processes and methodologies.
  • Stay abreast of industry developments, best practices, and regulatory requirements related to RBI and asset integrity management.
  • Ensure compliance with relevant safety standards, codes, and regulations governing inspection activities.

Communication and Collaboration:

  • Communicate RBI findings, recommendations, and inspection plans to stakeholders, including engineering teams, inspection and asset integrity personnel, and management.
  • Foster a culture of safety, reliability, and continuous improvement within the organization.
Education

Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering General or Chemical Engineering

Qualifications
  • Extensive experience in risk-based inspection, integrity management, or asset reliability engineering within the Oil & Gas facilities or power plant industry.
  • Proficiency in RBI methodologies, such as API RP 580/581, ASME PCC-3, or equivalent standards,
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret complex data and perform risk assessments.
  • Familiarity with inspection techniques, non-destructive testing (NDT) methods, and fitness-for-service assessment.
  • Knowledge of relevant industry codes, standards, and regulations, such as API, ASME, and OSHA.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively engage with stakeholders at all levels of the organization.
  • Detail-oriented mindset with a focus on quality, accuracy, and compliance in all aspects of work.
  • Ceritification in API 571 and API 580 is considered an added value.
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English. Spanish is desirable.
Additional Information
