Join to apply for the Software Engineer - Python - Ubuntu Pro client - graduate level role at Canonical

1 day ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Join to apply for the Software Engineer - Python - Ubuntu Pro client - graduate level role at Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

We are hiring a Software Engineer to develop, test and release improvements to the Ubuntu Pro client.

Ubuntu Pro is a suite of specialist services provided by Canonical. Whether for enterprise customers deploying systems at scale or users who want security patching for their personal Ubuntu LTS at home, the Ubuntu Pro Client is the command-line tool that manages all these services.

The quality and stability of the Ubuntu Pro Client is critically important, since it comes pre-installed on every Ubuntu system. You'll work with the Ubuntu Server team, alongside major cloud partners and multiple Canonical product teams to develop, test and release improvements to the Pro client. You will also be a voice in communication with our users, ensuring their needs are met.

This role requires quality-oriented software engineering in Python and a focus on software interoperability over a vast range of target releases and environments. Excellent Python skills are a key requirement, with previous contributions to open source Python projects being an advantage. The Pro client often interacts with the Ubuntu package management; therefore, experience in configuring apt, and knowledge of deb packaging and general system administration is advantageous in this role.

Applicants should be passionate about the Ubuntu project and its values and about building tools that are used by millions of people around the world. A personal interest and emphasis on quality, thinking of edge cases, ease of use, documentation, and careful community coordination is important. The Pro client is used at all ranges, from mission-critical environments to hobbyist Ubuntu users; applicants should be ready to work with the whole spectrum of end users and help guide engineering best practices with all of them in mind.

The role entails

  • Collaborate proactively with a distributed team
  • Write high quality code, with unit and functional tests, to create new features
  • Debug issues and produce high quality code to fix them
  • Review code produced by other engineers
  • Discuss ideas and investigate to find good solutions
  • Work from home, with global travel 2 to 4 weeks per year for internal and external events

What we are looking for in you

  • You love technology and working with brilliant people
  • You are curious, flexible, articulate, and accountable
  • You value soft skills and are passionate, enterprising, thoughtful, and self-motivated
  • You have a Bachelor's or equivalent in Computer Science, STEM or similar degree
  • You have extensive experience with Python on Linux
  • You have interest in and experience with two or more of the following: Ubuntu Linux systems administration, continuous integration, end-system contract management, Debian packaging, working with public or on premise clouds
  • Bonus points if you have experience engaging with the open source community

What we offer colleagues

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

The Company You’ll Join

Carta develops purpose-built software that transforms traditional accounting into a powerful growth engine.

Carta’s world-class fund administration platform supports nearly 7,000 funds and SPVs, and represents nearly $130B in assets under management in venture capital and private equity.

For more information about our offices and culture, check out our Carta careers page.

The Problems You'll Solve

At Carta, our employees set out on a mission to unlock the power of equity ownership for more people in more places. We believe that the problems we solve today unlock the opportunities of tomorrow.

As an Automation Engineering Manager, you will play a pivotal role in ensuring the reliability and robustness of automated test suites across critical workflows and high-usage products. You will lead a team of automation engineers, drive quality strategies and ensure seamless integration of automated testing throughout the software development lifecycle (SDLC).

Responsibilities:

  1. Leadership and Team Management:
  • Lead and mentor a team of QA Automation Engineers and Analysts in delivering high-quality automated tests
  • Conduct regular 1:1s, career development conversations, and performance reviews to support team members' growth
Automation Strategy:
  • Develop and maintain comprehensive testing frameworks and strategies for automated end-to-end tests
  • Ensure consistent automation coverage across products, prioritizing high-value user flows and critical paths
  • Collaborate with product managers and engineering teams to define minimal quality levels and implement continuous testing throughout the SDLC
Quality Assurance Execution:
  • Oversee the design and implementation of reliable automated test scenarios and regression suites using Carta-approved tools, such as Magni framework.
  • Monitor and maintain the health and reliability of automated tests, ensuring they are run consistently within the CI pipeline
  • Analyze defect rates and production incidents to refine testing methodologies
Collaboration and Communication:
  • Foster a culture of quality within engineering teams by advocating for early and consistent testing
  • Provide guidance, consultation, and mentorship to developers on automating tests and using QA tools effectively
  • Empower engineering teams to take ownership of test quality by providing necessary automation, resources, and support
Continuous Improvement:
  • Utilize AI models for automated triage, analysis of failed test runs, and suggesting remediations
  • Develop self-service automation tools and streamline process improvements to enhance developer productivity
  • Track quality metrics and drive progress towards team-specific and company-wide quality goals
About You
  • Proven experience as a QA Manager, with a strong background in automation testing
  • Proficiency in test automation frameworks using Selenium and/or Cypress
  • Solid understanding of SDLC and CI/CD pipeline integrations
  • Excellent leadership and team management skills
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities
  • Effective communication skills, with the ability to collaborate across functional teams.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience in leading technical teams, with a focus on quality strategy and automation
  • Familiarity with AI-driven testing tools and frameworks
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and manage multiple priorities

At Carta, you’re not just an employee. You’re a builder who is creating infrastructure that accelerates innovation and empowers more ownership. Cartans are helpful, relentless, unconventional and kind; representing Carta’s Identity Traits. They work collaboratively and cross functionally to challenge the status quo; working towards a common goal of creating more owners in the private markets.

title: Interpretation Geophysicist
description:
Join to apply for the Interpretation Geophysicist role at Viridien .

Viridien ( is an advanced technology, digital and Earth data company that pushes the boundaries of science for a more prosperous and sustainable future. With our ingenuity, drive and deep curiosity we discover new insights, innovations, and solutions that efficiently and responsibly resolve complex natural resource, digital, energy transition and infrastructure challenges.

Job Summary

We are looking for passionate geoscientists to join our Interpretation Team at Viridien. In this role, you will contribute directly to Velocity Model Building (VMB) by performing seismic interpretation and providing essential geological support to Processing and VMB teams. From picking horizons to building velocity scenarios, you will work at the intersection of geology, geophysics, and advanced imaging tools, helping to transform complex seismic data into meaningful insights. Your work will play a critical role in delivering high-quality results to our clients and shaping decisions across energy and earth-data projects.

Key Responsibilities
  • Perform seismic interpretation for VMB, including horizon picking (unconformities, salt horizons, pre-salt).
  • Create local velocity scenarios.
  • Apply imaging tools, workflows, and data QC (attributes, velocities, maps).
  • Integrate geological and geophysical data for deeper insights.
  • Engage directly with clients to present results and understand their perspectives.
About The Team

You will join a diverse group of interpreters, geologists, and geophysicists who collaborate closely with Processing and VMB teams. Together, we tackle complex challenges, share knowledge, and drive innovation in seismic imaging. At Viridien, collaboration is key — you will be encouraged to bring your ideas forward and grow in a supportive environment.

Qualifications
  • Master’s or PhD in Geophysics, Geology, or related field; or equivalent professional experience in the Oil & Gas industry.
  • Solid background in seismic interpretation, exploration geology, stratigraphy, or basin analysis.
  • Strong geophysical knowledge (seismic attributes, AVO, reservoir characterization, quantitative interpretation, well data QC/processing).
  • Ability to integrate data across scales (well, seismic, potential data).
  • Good understanding of seismic imaging and prospect assessment.
  • Experience with Pre-Salt or Brazilian Equatorial Margin is a plus.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving mindset.
  • Effective communication and presentation skills in English.
  • Python programming is a plus.
Benefits
  • Competitive salary with performance-based bonus.
  • Relocation package (when applicable).
  • Comprehensive health and dental insurance.
  • Private Pension Plan
  • Meal Voucher
  • Free breakfast and snacks at the office.

  • Hybrid Work Model (up to 2 remote days per week)
  • Birthday Day Off
  • Christmas Gift Card
  • Educational Assistance and Language Learning Programs
  • Continuous training via the Learning Hub, with both technical and behavioral courses.
Our Hiring Process

At Viridien, we are committed to delivering a respectful, inclusive, and transparent recruitment experience. We may not be able to provide individual feedback to every applicant due to high application volumes. Candidates whose qualifications closely match the role criteria will be contacted for an interview, and we aim to share personalized feedback with those who progress to the first round and beyond. If you require any reasonable adjustments to participate in the application or interview stages, please contact your recruiter directly. Responsabilidades:

O titular do cargo deverá garantir que:

description:

Join to apply for the OT Cybersecurity Technical Architect role at Voltalia

The OT Cybersecurity Technical Architect is responsible for designing and implementing the technical components of the organization's cybersecurity strategy. This role involves creating secure systems and network architectures, selecting and configuring security technologies, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to ensure the organization's digital assets are adequately protected.

  • Develop and implement OT cybersecurity architectures tailored for renewable energy production and operations.
  • Design secure and scalable network architectures for OT environments, including SCADA, IC…
  • Ensure OT security strategies align seamlessly with corporate IT and cybersecurity policies, while also adhering to industry standards, including IEC 62443 and ISO 27001.
  • Implement and supervise cybersecurity tools, including firewalls, intrusion detection systems, and vulnerability scanners, in OT environments.
  • Monitor and respond to OT security incidents, collaborating with incident response teams.
  • Collaborate with GRC team to address regulatory requirements.
  • Work closely with engineering, operations, and IT teams to integrate security into the lifecycle of OT assets.
  • Provide cybersecurity training and awareness programs for staff working with OT systems.
  • Engage with external vendors and partners to ensure secure deployment of third‑party OT solutions.
  • Stay updated on emerging cybersecurity threats, trends, and technologies relevant to OT environments.
  • Develop and implement strategies for continuous improvement of OT cybersecurity posture.
  • Lead pilot projects and proof‑of‑concept initiatives for new cybersecurity technologies.
QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCES
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
  • Minimum 5 years of experience in cybersecurity, with at least 2 years focusing on OT environments (e.g., SCADA, IC…)
  • Deep knowledge of OT systems and protocols, including Modbus, DNP3, OPC, and MQTT.
  • Proficiency with cybersecurity frameworks like IEC 62443, NIST CSF, and MITRE ATT&CK for IC…
  • Familiarity with firewalls, intrusion detection/prevention systems, and endpoint protection in OT environments.
  • Strong understanding of networking principles (e.g., VLANs, VPNs, routing).
  • Experience in renewable energy or other critical infrastructure industries is a plus.
  • CISSP, GICSP, CISM, or equivalent certifications preferred.
  • Proficiency both in Portuguese and English.
  • Availability for international travels.
KEY SKILLS
  • Strategic vision
  • Problem‑solving and organizational skills.
  • Strong ability to articulate technical concepts to non‑technical stakeholders and collaborate across multidisciplinary teams.
  • Proficiency in building relationships with internal and external partners to drive cybersecurity initiatives.
  • Resilient
  • Strong attention to detail to ensure precision in designing, implementing, and auditing cybersecurity measures.
  • Flexibility to respond to evolving cybersecurity threats and technological advancements.

Job type: Full-time employee Full-time employee

Somos a PRIO, a maior companhia independente de óleo e gás do Brasil. Buscamos continuamente por otimização de processos operacionais e de soluções inovadoras que visem diminuir os custos. Aqui todo trabalho é multidisciplinar e cada desafio é único!

Buscamos um(a) profissional com sólida experiência em E&P, com foco em contribuir para a eficiência e segurança na produção de petróleo e gás. Essa pessoa atuará diretamente na área de produção dos ativos, colaborando com diversas equipes da companhia, como G&G, Reservatórios, SMS, Manutenção, entre outras.

  • Gerenciar a produção dos campos, garantindo seu bom desempenho;
  • Monitorar o rendimento dos poços e propor melhorias e programas de estimulação para otimizar resultados;
  • Resolver desafios operacionais com agilidade e visão técnica;
  • Apoiar a qualidade do escoamento dos campos;
  • Ser referência técnica em sistemas de elevação artificial (BCS e GL);
  • Oferecer suporte técnico aos times embarcados e de escritório, desenvolvendo manuais e procedimentos;
  • Participar da especificação e seleção de materiais e serviços, contribuindo na avaliação de propostas;
  • Gerenciar escopos de trabalho relacionados à elevação artificial, incluindo fornecedores e contratadas;
  • Elaborar orçamentos e planos para estudos ou modificações específicas, acompanhando o controle de custos;
  • Monitorar KPIs, custos operacionais e metas da área de produção;
  • Atuar de forma estratégica no processo de gerenciamento de mudanças.
  • Formação superior em Engenharia de Petróleo, Mecânica ou Química
  • Vivência com produção, escoamento e sistemas de elevação artificial (BCS);
  • Conhecimento em operação e revitalização de campos maduros;
  • Experiência com equipamentos e instalações submarinas;
  • Inglês avançado
  • Será um diferencial ter conhecimento em reservatórios e operações em poços (workover, completion, drilling).

Como é o processo seletivo na PRIO?

Gostamos de já chegar na entrevista te conhecendo um pouco, então pedimos a você que preencha ainda na etapa de cadastro alguns testes para podermos avaliar o seu Match com a nossa Cultura :)

Depois, nós do time de RH vamos marcar um papo com você. A ideia aqui é aprofundar um pouco mais nas suas experiências, buscando o alinhamento com o perfil da vaga e comportamental que buscamos para a PRIO. Ah, nesse papo também vamos falar sobre a companhia, fluxo do processo, benefícios e tirar suas dúvidas!

Dica: Nesse nosso papo, vamos querer saber sobre experiências que você já vivenciou, alinhadas aos valores da PRIO. A ideia é que você consiga nos apresentar essas vivências de forma completa, com contextos, sua responsabilidade, o que você fez e qual foi o resultado!

Em seguida, vamos adentrando em aspectos mais técnicos, que podem envolver um case ou apenas uma entrevista com o(a) gestor(a) da vaga, aonde você poderá conhecer um pouco mais sobre os desafios técnicos da vaga e será avaliado dentro dos requisitos da vaga.

Ao fim, os finalistas conversam com o diretor da respectiva área para a escolha final!

Como se preparar para o processo seletivo na PRIO:

-Pesquise sobre o negócio da companhia e nossa atuação no setor de óleo e gás;

-Busque se atualizar sobre as notícias recentes da companhia, sejam da imprensa ou divulgadas em nosso site de relações com investidores;

-Acesses nossas redes sociais para conhecer mais sobre como é trabalhar na PRIO!

-Pense na sua história e principais realizações. Estruture seus resultados e conquistas para relatá-los na hora da entrevista.

Fale dos sucessos, mas entender as falhas e como você aprendeu com elas também é importante. Prezamos pela transparência, por isso, não tenha medo de falar sobre os seus insucessos.

Desejamos a você um bom processo seletivo!

  • Step 3: Avaliação de Perfis 3 Avaliação de Perfis
Venha fazer parte da PRIO

Somos a PRIO, a maior companhia independente de óleo e gás do Brasil. Buscamos continuamente por otimização de processos operacionais e de soluções inovadoras que visem diminuir os custos. Aqui todo trabalho é multidisciplinar e cada desafio é único!

Com foco no investimento e na recuperação de ativos em produção, somos especializados na gestão eficiente de reservatórios e no redesenvolvimento de campos maduros. Acreditamos na condução dos negócios, com foco em segurança e cuidado com a saúde dos seus colaboradores.

Nosso ambiente de trabalho

Oferecemos um ambiente de trabalho dinâmico e com muitas oportunidades de participação em diferentes projetos, favorecendo o desenvolvimento profissional e o crescimento do time. Trabalhamos em um escritório open space , o que permite a integração entre todas as equipes e a Diretoria, onde todos podem participar da tomada de decisões.

Nossa cultura busca o alto desempenho e a participação efetiva de todas as pessoas. Se você sonha em se desenvolver junto com uma empresa em constante crescimento, venha fazer parte do nosso time!

Objetivo do Cargo

Atuar no desenvolvimento e manutenção de aplicativos móveis híbridos para iOS e Android, garantindo qualidade, performance e escalabilidade das soluções entregues. Responsabilidades
  • Desenvolver e manter aplicativos híbridos (Ionic/Angular/Capacitor) para iOS e Android.
  • Integrar os apps a Web APIs em C#/.NET e apoiar melhorias de performance e escalabilidade.
  • Atuar em processos de build, pipelines, automação de releases (App Store, Google Play, TestFlight).

Escolaridade

Graduação completa ou em andamento em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas.

Experiência
  • Experiência sólida em desenvolvimento mobile híbrido (Ionic/Angular/Capacitor).
  • Vivência em projetos com C#/.NET e Web APIs RESTful.
  • Atuação em processos de publicação e distribuição de aplicativos (internos e externos).
  • Vivência com metodologias ágeis (Scrum/Kanban).
Competências Técnicas
  • Forte conhecimento em C#/.NET e integração com APIs RESTful.
  • Experiência em CI/CD, pipelines, TestFlight, App Store Connect e Google Play Console.
  • Conhecimento em refatoração de código, boas práticas, SOLID e clean code.
  • Experiência com testes (unitários, integrados e automatizados) em projetos mobile.
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de monitoramento (AppCenter, Firebase Crashlytics).
Competências Comportamentais
  • Proatividade e autonomia na execução de tarefas.
  • Colaboração e espírito de equipe multidisciplinar.
  • Organização e atenção aos detalhes.
  • Comunicação clara e eficaz.
  • Capacidade de adaptação a mudanças e foco em resultados.
Diferenciais
  • Experiência com macOS para builds iOS.
  • Conhecimento em arquitetura limpa (Clean Architecture, DDD, MVVM, etc.).
  • Experiência em ambientes de alta disponibilidade e escalabilidade.
  • Conhecimento em segurança e boas práticas de API Mobile.
Informações da Vaga
  • Vaga: Desenvolvedor(a) Mobile Pleno/Sênior.

  • Ambiente colaborativo e dinâmico.

  • Cultura de feedback e aprendizado contínuo.
Informações da Empresa

A ASC Solutions é especializada em fornecer tecnologia de gestão profissional para clubes e associações esportivas. Atuando desde 1986, com sedes no Rio de Janeiro e São Paulo, a empresa desenvolve soluções dedicadas por meio de sua fábrica de software, oferecendo consultoria técnica especializada para empresas de TI e terceirização de projetos. A ASC Solutions se destaca pela inovação constante, suporte eficiente e implantação assistida, sempre com foco na melhoria dos processos de gestão de seus clientes.

Para saber mais sobre a nossa empresa, acesse nosso site: ascsolutions.com.br. Não deixe de conferir nossas soluções e valores!

description:
Join to apply for the Gerente Contábil role at Forvis Mazars no Brasil

DESCRIÇÃO

Junte-se a Forvis Mazars. Você é movido por desafios, tem sede de aprendizado e quer construir uma carreira sólida em uma empresa global, essa vaga é pra você!

Sobre Nós

Seja parte de uma empresa líder em auditoria, consultoria tributária e consultoria empresarial, com presença em mais de 100 países e uma equipe de mais de 40.000 profissionais. Aqui, você terá acesso a exposição global, desenvolvimento contínuo e projetos que fazem a diferença.

Na Forvis Mazars, você cresce e pertence a uma rede diversa e gera impacto no mundo dos negócios e na sociedade. Faça parte de um ambiente colaborativo, onde suas ideias são valorizadas e onde o sucesso acontece em equipe.

Sua Jornada Conosco

Aqui, você terá a chance de trabalhar com um time de alto nível atendendo clientes globais, construindo conexões valiosas e evoluindo suas habilidades e competências. Oferecemos programas de treinamento focados no seu crescimento e qualificação, programas de desenvolvimento & performance e um ambiente que promove a excelência e aprendizado. Além do trabalho, cuidamos do seu bem-estar, garantindo um ambiente acolhedor, cultivando a riqueza das relações interpessoais.

Sobre a área

Na nossa Contabilidade você terá oportunidades de desenvolvimento profissional com interações e responsabilidades entre as principais linhas de frente de negócio, através disso você terá um contato maior com o time no que tange ao processo contábil desde o início de um projeto até o fim.

  • Representar a área contábil em reuniões comerciais e estratégicas, contribuindo para o crescimento da base de clientes e a ampliação dos serviços prestados;
  • Liderar e desenvolver a equipe contábil (supervisores, analistas e assistentes), promovendo um ambiente colaborativo e focado em resultados;
  • Estabelecer e acompanhar indicadores de desempenho da área, propondo melhorias contínuas em processos, sistemas e atendimento;

title: SDR - B2C
description:
Overview

Tudo o que fazemos é por acreditar que existe um grande potencial não explorado em cada ser humano. Nosso propósito é transformar a vida das pessoas ao descobrir sua melhor versão. Somos o melhor curso de comunicação e oratória do Brasil; ajudamos pessoas e empresas a melhorarem suas performances e resultados através de uma metodologia única e inovadora que combina técnicas de oratória, fonoaudiologia, neurociência, psicologia positiva e técnicas teatrais.

Nossa cultura: No nosso dia a dia, nos propomos a fazer diferente na vida dos nossos clientes e colaboradores de forma única e eficiente, porque acreditamos que cada ser humano é único e tem grande potencial a ser descoberto e desenvolvido. Isso se tangibiliza em atitudes práticas e em nossos valores:

  • Excelência: Ter compromisso por fazer o melhor, sempre. Valorizar o cuidado com os detalhes e a busca constante pela alta qualidade em tudo o que faz.
  • Coragem: Encarar as mudanças e desafios de frente, com confiança e determinação, acreditando que cada adversidade é uma oportunidade para o crescimento e transformação.
  • Inovação: Inovar com paixão e estar sempre em busca de novas ideias e soluções que tragam resultados impactantes, transformando vidas.
  • Sabedoria: Aprender e crescer continuamente. Investir em conhecimento e desenvolvimento e garantir o sucesso em tudo o que se propõe a fazer.
  • Bom humor: Cultivar um ambiente leve e descontraído. Saber encarar os desafios com positividade e leveza.
  • Acolhimento: Priorizar as pessoas, cuidar das relações e contribuir para um ambiente de trabalho saudável.

Seus Principais Objetivos São:

  • Conectar com leads quentes e frios, com foco em gerar novas oportunidades de negócios;
  • Qualificar prospects e entender suas necessidades;
  • Aprimoramento e captação de informações comerciais;
  • Mapear oportunidades de venda e realizar a oferta de nossos produtos/serviços;
  • Agendar reunião para fechamento da venda entre o potencial cliente e nossos executivos de venda;
  • Qualificar e desenvolver os leads gerados por nossas estratégias de marketing;
  • Atualizar as informações no CRM e softwares de sales engagement com pontos relevantes sobre as oportunidades identificadas;
  • Trabalhar o social selling e aprofundar relacionamento com os leads por meio de canais sociais.

Procuramos por Pessoas (atentem-se às soft skills abaixo):

  • Pessoas com raciocínio lógico;
  • Bom relacionamento interpessoal;
  • Ótima dicção;
  • Adaptabilidade;
  • Visão sistêmica;
  • Solucionadoras de problemas;
  • Criativas e empreendedoras;
  • Organizadas e disciplinadas para contribuir com a performance do time;
  • Que AMEM trabalhar em equipe (aqui não aceitamos egoísmo, nem competições não saudáveis);
  • Resilientes e Pacientes (confortáveis no desconforto e lidando com o desconhecido);
  • Proativas e Independentes (com vontade de aprender e resolver problemas de forma autônoma);
  • Que tenham espírito empreendedor.

Requisitos:

  • Pacote Office básico;
  • Facilidade de comunicação e escrita;
  • Ensino médio completo;
  • Facilidade em aprender coisas novas.

Diferenciais:

  • Ensino Superior em andamento;
  • Facilidade com ferramentas de tecnologia;
  • Noções básicas de inglês; Experiência como SDR;
  • Conhecimento prévio na metodologia SPIN Selling;
  • Conhecimento de CRM.

Em troca, você terá:

title: TÉCNICO DE FARMACIA - DIARISTA - HOSPITAL MUNICIPAL PEDRO II
description:
Job description

Desde dezembro de 2015, a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Municipal Pedro II .

A infraestrutura do Hospital conta com dez andares, nos quais estão distribuídos os serviços de emergência e de Unidade de Tratamento Intensivo (UTI) adulta, pediátrica e neonatal; maternidade; clínica médica, cirurgia-geral e bucomaxilofacial, neurocirurgia, psiquiatria, pediatria e ortopedia. Exames de imagem (raio X, tomografia, ultrassonografia, eletrocardiografia, ecocardiografia) e laboratoriais também são realizados na unidade.

Devido à grande população de idosos da Zona Oeste, região assistida pelo Hospital Municipal Pedro II (HMPII), há duas Enfermarias destinadas ao atendimento desse público.

O Centro de Tratamento de Queimados é outro diferencial entre os serviços oferecidos, e que dispõe de uma UTI exclusiva para prevenir infecções, que podem ser muito graves para quem está com queimaduras.

Além disso, a unidade conta com a Coordenação de Emergência Regional (CER) Santa Cruz, que possui 39 leitos, e tem como objetivo absorver as demandas de menor complexidade, deixando o HMPII liberado para os casos de risco iminente de morte, necessidade de cirurgia urgente e/ou internação. Um diferencial deste CER é o fato de possuir atendimento especializado em Psiquiatria e Obstetrícia.

Main responsibilities

Atuar com as rotinas de farmácia hospitalar, recebendo, armazenando, separando e dispensando medicamentos e materiais, sob a supervisão direta do Farmacêutico.

Requirements and skills

Curso Técnico em Farmácia completo

Experiência mínima de 06 meses como Técnico de Farmácia

Additional information

Santa Cruz - RJ

description:

Transformar a área de vendas em uma operação baseada em dados e eficiência, elevando as taxas de fechamento e contribuindo para o crescimento da empresa. Você atuará como o elo entre a estratégia e sua aplicação prática, eliminando ruídos e aumentando a produtividade do time de vendas.

Você ajudará também a pensar em marketing ops, no que cabe os indicadores de geração de demanda via inbound e outras origens de negócios para o time comercial, auxiliando a definir os processos e tecnologias necessários para que a área funcione da melhor maneira possível.

Você atuará com o CRM do Hubspot, tanto em vendas, quanto em marketing.

  1. Análise de Dados:

    • Analisar diariamente as métricas de vendas (aquisição e expansão) e marketing vinculadas ao processo de vendas dentro do Hubspot.

    • Propor sugestões sobre o processo de vendas com base em análise de dados.
    • Ser proativo na identificação de novas oportunidades de melhorias no processo de vendas (aquisição e expansão) por meio das análises de dados.

    • Cumprir prazos e cronogramas.

    • Gerenciar todos os relatórios, melhorias e modificações do sistema de CRM.

title: Gerente de Vendas - Trul Hotéis
description:
Sobre Nós:

O prazer é todo nosso ; )

Cada hotel tem uma característica especial. Muitas vezes, o grande desafio é encontrar qual e desenvolver o seu potencial. Por isso, a Trul é a primeira operadora multimarcas de Minas Gerais a aplicar o conceito de Customização Hoteleira. O que, em outras palavras, significa entender o que um hotel tem de melhor para, assim, desenvolver marcas e experiências únicas para o hóspede.

A Trul é detalhista e completa: cuida da implantação à operação hoteleira. Acompanha cada detalhe para garantir a gestão eficiente e necessária para atrair clientes e, claro, criar motivos para que eles voltem sempre. =)

Descrição:

Atuar estrategicamente e de forma prática na prospecção de clientes, manutenção de contas e desenvolvimento de parcerias, visando o aumento da receita do hotel. Responsável pelo plano de vendas, análise de mercado e alcance de metas comerciais, com ou sem gestão de equipe.

Atividades:

  • Realizar pesquisas de mercado em busca de oportunidades de negócios, utilizando técnicas de vendas de forma eficaz, com o objetivo de atingir as metas individuais, da TRUL HOTÉIS e de seus parceiros.
  • Prospectar e captar clientes para a TRUL HOTÉIS e seus parceiros, sendo responsável pelo primeiro contato e pelo registro no sistema, comprometendo-se a manter as informações sempre atualizadas.
  • Desenvolver relacionamentos com agências de viagens, operadoras de turismo, companhias aéreas, contas corporativas (empresas) e demais geradores de negócios para a TRUL HOTÉIS e seus parceiros.
  • Mapear a região primária, secundária e regiões metropolitanas de atuação, identificando clientes potenciais e otimizando recursos para evitar custos e deslocamentos desnecessários.
  • Posicionar estrategicamente os hotéis representados junto às contas-chave (Key Accounts) da praça ou região, atendendo suas necessidades e contribuindo para o aumento do share da TRUL HOTÉIS.
  • Atualizar regularmente todas as informações referentes às contas, rotinas e leads no sistema, bem como arquivos relacionados (tarifários, acordos, termos de convênio, contratos de grupos e eventos, entre outros).
  • Planejar, desenvolver e executar planos de ação comercial semestrais, apoiando colegas e equipes internas, com foco na fidelização das contas sob sua gestão e no incremento da produção da TRUL HOTÉIS e seus parceiros.
  • Realizar análises, levantamento de dados e pesquisas de performance das contas, buscando constantemente o aumento da produção ou a manutenção dos resultados obtidos.
  • Vender e fomentar o relacionamento dos clientes com os demais hotéis da TRUL HOTÉIS e seus parceiros, negociando condições comerciais sempre alinhadas com os pares, o Head de Vendas e os Gerentes Gerais.
  • Realizar follow-ups para atualização de tarifários, negociações e contratos preferenciais.
  • Revisar orçamentos e propostas com foco em conversão.
  • Coletar feedbacks pós-venda.
  • Tratar reclamações ou problemas em conjunto com as equipes operacionais, o Head de Vendas e os Gerentes Gerais, sempre que necessário.
  • Participar da construção e desenvolvimento de estratégias em conjunto com os pares, equipe interna, Revenue Management (RM) e Marketing, visando atingir as metas definidas no Budget anual.
  • Acompanhar o andamento das ações estratégicas de Marketing, participando ativamente das reuniões com o time interno, sempre que solicitado.
  • Realizar ações de fidelização, ativações, visitas e apresentações de novidades, produtos e serviços da TRUL HOTÉIS e seus parceiros, mantendo o relacionamento ativo com os clientes.
  • Apresentar semanalmente ao Head Nacional de Vendas, Gerentes Gerais e pares comerciais um relatório de atividades realizadas, bem como a agenda de atividades previstas para a semana seguinte (seguir guia padrão).
  • Participar do fechamento mensal de vendas e colaborar na construção da apresentação de resultados, sempre que solicitado.
  • Fomentar o networking comercial por meio da participação em feiras, eventos, congressos, reuniões corporativas, rodadas de negócios, entre outros, representando a TRUL HOTÉIS e seus parceiros.
  • Executar tarefas designadas pelo Head de Vendas ou Gerente Geral, com o objetivo de apoiar os hotéis da sua praça no cumprimento de suas metas.
  • Prestar contas de viagens e gastos extras de acordo com a política interna de viagens da TRUL HOTÉIS.

Para a vaga consideramos necessário:

  • Graduação completa em Turismo, Gestão em Hotelaria, Administração, Marketing, Gestão Comercial ou áreas afins.
  • Vendas na área de Hotelaria ou Turismo.
  • Experiência mínima de 2 anos na área comercial.
  • Negociação com pequenas, médias, grandes contas.

Para a vaga consideramos desejável:

  • Vivência em hotéis de rede ou hotéis independentes;
  • Conhecimentos RM;
  • Inglês intermediário/avançado.

You will report to our Chief Operations Officer and join the Finance team. On TheOrg you can view the complete structure of our organisation, including information about every team member, hiring managers, and the size of each department.

We’re looking for a strategic and hands‑on Head Of Finance to lead the transformation of our financial operations into a data‑driven, scalable, and globally compliant structure. The ideal candidate has strong experience in high‑growth tech startups or SaaS companies , thrives in distributed and multicultural teams , and knows how to connect finance, data, and technology to drive intelligent decision‑making. You’ll play a key role in helping Rocket.Chat reach its next stage of maturity — balancing governance, automation, and growth efficiency in a company that powers secure collaboration for clients around the world.

Qualifications
  • Proven experience as CFO, Finance Director, or Head of Finance in startups or tech companies (preferably SaaS or open‑source models).
  • Strong background in FP&A, Controllership, Accounting, and Financial Planning.
  • Hands‑on experience with ERP systems (preferably NetSuite) and financial process automation.
  • Solid understanding of global financial operations, including taxation and compliance in the US, Brazil, and Europe.
  • Solid knowledge of processes and budgetary controls.
  • Proficiency in strategically managing cash balance/runway, financial modelling, forecasting, and performance metrics (MRR, LTV, CAC, churn, margins).
  • Knowledge of international accounting standards (specifically US GAAP).
  • Fluent English communication skills (reports and meetings in English).
  • Proven ability to restructure and develop finance teams, while embedding agile methodologies and governance frameworks to drive process optimization and strategic alignment.
  • Experience in open‑source or hybrid SaaS/enterprise business models.
  • Familiarity with CRM and payment integrations (Zoho, Stripe, Jira).
  • Understanding of data analytics and BI tools (Power BI, Zoho Analytics).
  • Exposure to fundraising, Series A/B stages, M&A and investor relations.
  • Experience collaborating with technical and data teams (e.g., AWS cost efficiency, data pipelines, metric creation).
  • Passion: Genuine enthusiasm for what you do and how it contributes to our mission of enabling secure, open, and collaborative communication worldwide.
  • Dream: Proactively seek opportunities and challenges to achieve extraordinary results — bringing a growth mindset and ambition to scale a global company.
  • Own: Show strong ownership and accountability by taking responsibility for outcomes, maintaining high standards, and fostering both structure and innovation to deliver meaningful impact.
  • Trust: Build trust through reliability and empathy, fostering collaboration across distributed teams and time zones.
  • Share: Communicate openly and transparently, ensuring clarity and honesty in all interactions — especially when connecting finance with data and operations.
  • Self‑Awareness & Growth Mindset: Self‑awareness (desire and ability to constructively critique performance) and ability to identify root‑cause of errors and seek continuous improvement.
Responsibilities
  • Lead the financial transformation of Rocket.Chat — redesigning processes, governance, and structure to support sustainable global growth.

title: Senior QA Automation Engineer II
description:
15 hours ago Be among the first 25 applicants

The Company You’ll Join

Carta connects founders, investors, and limited partners through world-class software, purpose-built for everyone in venture capital, private equity and private credit.

Carta’s fund administration platform supports nearly 7,000 funds and SPVs, representing $150B in assets under administration in venture capital and private equity. Trusted by more than 40,000 companies, Carta also helps private businesses in over 160 countries manage their cap tables, valuations, taxes, equity programs, compensation, and more.

Together, Carta is creating the end-to-end ERP platform for private markets. Traditional ERP solutions don’t work for Private Funds. Private capital markets need a comprehensive software solution to replace outdated spreadsheets and fragmented service providers. Carta’s software for the Office of the Fund CFO does just that - it’s a new category of software to make private markets look more like public markets - a connected ERP for private capital.

For more information about our offices and culture, check out our Carta careers page.

The Problems You'll Solve

At Carta, our employees set out on a mission to unlock the power of equity ownership for more people in more places. We believe that the problems we solve today unlock the opportunities of tomorrow. To do this well, we must continuously raise the bar on software quality—without compromising developer velocity.

As a Senior QA Automation Engineer II , you won’t just be writing tests—you’ll be a force multiplier for quality across the engineering organization. You’ll work across multiple product teams to drive a strategic shift: from QA as a safety net to quality as a shared responsibility, embedded into every part of the development lifecycle.

You’ll lead efforts to identify critical coverage gaps, implement and scale test automation frameworks, and roll out self-service tools that enable developers to write, run, and promote tests with confidence. You’ll partner closely with embedded QAs, developers, and platform teams to shift QA towards an enablement model that amplifies impact across teams.

You’ll help pilot new ways of working that reduce manual effort, catch defects earlier, and improve the signal-to-noise ratio in our CI pipeline—whether through smarter automation, better tooling, or new AI-integrated approaches to test reliability and triage. Ultimately, your work will help Carta move faster without sacrificing confidence—by making automated quality an invisible but essential part of our software delivery process.

The Team You'll Work With

The QA Organization consists of ~15 QAs who work closely with our Product, Engineering, and Support teams. We work cross-functionally across the organization to make sure we are testing our product before our clients get to use them. This is a highly visible and critical role to help define and implement QA processes within different teams, plus help with manual and automation testing to test our products thoroughly and deliver with high quality.

About You

  • Fluency in English with strong written and verbal communication skills (we communicate closely with global teams on a daily basis!)
  • 6-8+ years of experience in software engineering or automation engineering role
  • Strong programming expertise in one OOP language like Python, Java, JS or Go (Python preferred)
  • Experience building and maintaining test frameworks using tools like Selenium/Webdriver, Pytest, Cypress, Playwright
  • Deep practical understanding of test strategies (unit, integration, E2E, performance, load testing).
  • Understanding of CI/CD and hands on experience with building and deployment tools (CircleCI, Jenkins, ArgoCD, Docker) and test analytics (e.g., Datadog, Sentry)
  • Strong experience with automation and software design patterns, with proven experience in both backend and frontend projects
  • Strong knowledge in cloud infrastructure and container orchestration (Kubernetes preferred)
  • You have the ability to understand the technical needs for the teams and help them implement QA processes and mindset
  • You are a self-starter who thrives on solving open-ended problems, not just executing Jira tickets
  • You identify patterns and recurring issues proactively and build scalable solutions to reduce future friction
  • You have a history of shipping test frameworks or systems used by others beyond your immediate team.
  • You have a track record of advancing quality maturity by shifting QA from hands-on execution to developer enablement through self-service tooling and process improvements
  • You are passionate about mentoring junior level team members to help them grow and learn

Please note: Please submit your resume in English. This role will be hybrid in our Rio office.

description:

Senior Site Reliability / Gitops Engineer

1 day ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Join to apply for the Senior Site Reliability / Gitops Engineer role at Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

We are hiring a Senior Site Reliability / Gitops Engineer to our Information Systems (IS) team. This role is an opportunity for an "automation-first" senior technologist with a passion for Linux to build a career with Canonical and drive the success with those leveraging Ubuntu and open source products. If you have experience of IT operations automation, Infrastructure as Code and a passion for technology, then you will enjoy working with some of the best people in the industry at Canonical.

Job Summary

The IS team at Canonical supports and maintains all of Canonical's IT production services. The team is in charge of running services used by over 60 million Ubuntu users.

As an Senior SRE & Gitops engineer you'll be in a unique position to drive operations automation to the next level, both in our own private clouds as well as in the public clouds. We do this by utilizing the best of open source infrastructure as code software, software development practices such as CI/CD pipelines, and Canonical's leading products for software operation automation.

In addition to defining the infrastructure as code, you will improve Canonical products and the open-source technologies they're based on by providing critical feedback to developers on how their products operate at scale. This is done by submitting bugs (and sometimes writing pull requests) and collaborating on design and implementations with other teams within the company.

You'll be part of a global team of SREs that work together and support each other to provide the best possible services to our company, Canonical's customers and the Ubuntu Community.

As a Senior Site Reliability / Gitops Engineer you will

  • Drive the development of automation, Gitops in your team as an embedded tech lead
  • Closely collaborate with the IS architect to align your solutions with the IS architecture vision
  • Design and architect services that IS can offer to the organization as products
  • Apply your experience of IaC to develop infrastructure as code practice within IS by constantly increasing automation and improving IaC processes
  • Automate software operations for re-usability and consistency across private and public clouds, taking into consideration the complexities of distributed systems
  • Maintain operational responsibility for all of Canonical's core services, networks, and infrastructure
  • Develop skills in troubleshooting, capacity planning, and performance investigation, Setting up, maintaining and using observability tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, and Elasticsearch; design, implement and maintain monitoring and alerting for various systems and services
  • Provide assistance and work with globally distributed engineering, operations, and support peers
  • Be given uninterrupted development time to focus on larger projects and automation of manual tasks
  • Share your experience, know-how and best practices with other team members in design sessions, mentorship and 'doing work together'
  • Carry final responsibility for time-critical escalations

What we are looking for in you

  • A modern view on hosting architecture, driven by infrastructure as code across both private and public clouds.
  • A product mindset thriving to develop products rather than solutions.
  • Python software development experience, with large projects
  • Experience working with Kubernetes or other container orchestration systems.
  • Proven exposure to manage and deploy cloud infrastructure with code.
  • Practical knowledge of Linux networking, routing, and firewalls
  • Affinity with various forms of Linux storage, from Ceph to Databases
  • Hands-on experience administering enterprise Linux servers
  • Extensive knowledge of cloud computing concepts and technologies
  • Bachelor's degree or greater, preferably in computer science or related engineering field
  • Able to communicate clearly and effectively in English over email, chat, video or voice calls and in-person
  • Motivated and able to troubleshoot from kernel to web, and willing to ask others when appropriate
  • A willingness to be flexible and able to learn new things quickly
  • Be inspired by the needs of fast-changing environments
  • Happy to work within distributed teams
  • Be passionate and familiarized about open-source, especially Ubuntu or Debian

What we offer colleagues

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Donorbox is a leading fundraising platform and donor management system for nonprofit organizations. Our mission is to accelerate positive impact worldwide by helping nonprofits become highly effective at raising funds and managing their supporter base. Since 2014, we have powered more than 100,000 global organizations to close to $3B in donations.

Our fast-growing company is profitable and bootstrapped with a healthy run rate. We have a fully distributed and diverse 150-person team based in 16+ states and 23+ countries.

Donorbox is rated the #1 software for fundraising, donor management, and nonprofit payment on G2 based on hundreds of verified customer reviews. We're proud of what we do, and our product reflects it!

The Role

Donorbox is seeking a Product Analyst to join our growing team. Reporting directly to the Director of Product, the person will be a key player in helping our product teams make data-driven decisions. The role's primary focus will be on defining, implementing, and analyzing product metrics such as in-app events and conversion funnels. The person will also be responsible for ensuring the integrity and accuracy of our data collection, acting as a crucial link between our Product and Data departments. They will work closely with product managers and designers to provide the insights they need to build and iterate on successful features, and track the key results for each objective of every product team.

Responsibilities

  • Define and track key product success metrics across various product teams, including quarterly OKRs.
  • Work with product managers to establish, implement, and analyze product conversion funnels.
  • Collaborate with engineering teams to ensure accurate and complete data collection for all new product launches and feature updates.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for product usage data requests from the design team, providing them with the necessary insights to inform their decisions.
  • Bridge the communication and technical gap between the Product and Data departments, translating business needs into data requirements.
  • Monitor data quality and integrity, troubleshooting and resolving any issues related to event tracking or data loss.
  • Assist in setting up and analyzing A/B tests and other experimental feature rollouts.
  • Prepare and present regular reports and dashboards on product performance to stakeholders.

Qualifications & Experience

  • Minimum 5 years of experience as a Product Analyst or in a similar data-focused role.
  • Deep expertise in web analytics platforms such as Google Analytics 4 (GA4) and Google Tag Manager (GTM).
  • Hands-on experience with advanced product analytics tools like Heap, Posthog, or Pendo, including successful implementation and ongoing use.
  • Experience with A/B testing and feature rollout platforms.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a keen eye for detail.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across different teams.
  • Proficiency in data visualization tools (e.g., Looker Studio, Tableau, Power BI).
  • Experience with SQL for data querying and analysis.

Bonus

  • Familiarity with data warehousing concepts and technologies.
  • Experience in a high-growth or startup environment.
  • Knowledge of scripting languages like Python or R for data analysis.
  • Background in user experience (UX) or product design.
  • Familiarity with agile development methodologies.

Details

  • Fully remote based in Latin America
  • Salary: $25k-$35k USD, depending on experience and location

Benefits & Perks

  • Eligibility for employee equity plan (stock options)

  • Generous time off policy of 21 days (birthday included ), 8 holidays of your choice, and 2 paid volunteer days
  • Wellness program with fitness and mindfulness classes
  • Love your work and our mission of serving nonprofits!

OH, BOY! Com 26 lojas próprias e presente em mais de 800 multimarcas, a OH, BOY! é uma marca carioca de coração, que possui essência descontraída, urbana e jovem. Esta leveza se traduz em coleções confortáveis, femininas e descontraídas que misturam influências e estilos refletindo nossa personalidade plural. title: Customer Success - Team Manager
description:
Join or sign in to find your next job

Join to apply for the Customer Success - Team Manager role at Canonical

16 hours ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Join to apply for the Customer Success - Team Manager role at Canonical

Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1000+ colleagues in 70+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder led, profitable and growing.

We are hiring a Customer Success - Team Manager.

To support Canonical's growth, we are expanding our CSM team globally and recruiting leaders to help our team of Customer Success Managers across regions. We consider our Customer Success operations an exceptional tool to sustain revenue retention and growth, placing excellence in delivering outstanding customer services in the new technologies sector. As such, we are looking for exceptional candidates with proven track records in Customer Success and an obvious passion for new technologies. Ideally, you have been a Customer Success Manager at one point in your career and naturally evolved to a leading position.

You will enjoy this role if you are organised, persistent, analytical, diplomatic, a listener, hard-working, and determined to grow your skills and teams. As a lead, you are to provide mentoring, coaching in post-sales account management and feedback to team members. You play a crucial role in proactively identifying areas of improvement and implementing process change, driving high-performing teams. You are comfortable dealing with ambiguity and quickly adapt to changes. You seek collaboration with other teams to enhance the overall customer experience. Your key responsibility is to analyze regional performance metrics, identify trends and opportunities for improvement, and implement changes to increase efficiency and achieve business objectives. You will work hand-in-hand with the Head of Customer Success.

CSMs engage a diverse customer base and follow diverse CSM motions to provide the appropriate level of focus for every customer. The right candidate would adapt to this diversity and bring broad experience to the team.

Location: This is a globally remote role

The role entails:

  • Strategic planning and analysis: preparing communication plans, Team Meetings, and other messages shared in broader management forums, setting yourself and your team up for success. Regularly reviewing key performance indicators and metrics is your baseline. You develop strategies to enhance customer engagement, improve retention rates, drive upsells or cross-sells where appropriate, and ultimately increase customer success.
  • Customer interactions and support to your team: you resolve escalated customer issues requiring expertise or intervention. You work closely with your team members to ensure timely resolution.
  • Team management: you are passionate about guiding and supporting your team members, helping them navigate complex customer situations, improve their skills, and achieve their goals. You are ready for regular performance reviews with team members. While your help in identifying areas for improvement is key, you are asked to celebrate excellence, recognise your team's achievements, and set goals for individual growth within the team.
  • Cross-functional collaboration: collaboration with other departments, such as Sales, Marketing, Product development, and Support, is essential. This ensures alignment on customer needs, feedback sharing, and coordinated efforts to drive customer success. You establish trustworthy channels of communication across the board.
  • Documentation and reporting: you are allowed to be creative! While building content with your team and your manager, you also ensure the changes are well documented, instilling quality and attention to detail in all you do.

What we are looking for in you

  • Excellent academic results at school and university
  • Bachelor's or equivalent degree in Business, Communication or STEM
  • Knowledge and passion for Customer Success, revenue management and technology, experience in SaaS or software industries
  • Track record of bringing exceptional Customer Success experience results
  • Commitment to continuous learning and improvement - curious, flexible, scientific
  • Creative problem-solving and cross-team collaboration
  • Experience growing and developing a CSM team
  • Hands-on approach to using data to drive team activities and continuous improvement
  • Willingness to travel up to 4 times a year for internal events

Nice-to-have skills

  • We at the Customer Success team strongly appreciate various languages! Therefore, if you possess proficiency (both written and spoken) in Japanese, Korean, Spanish, Portuguese, German, French, or Italian, alongside an excellent command of English, please inform us!

What we offer you

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person - we've been working remotely since 2004!
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues from your team and others
  • Priority Pass for travel and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

title: Senior Product Designer (UI/UX)
description:
XILO , a fast-growing Vertical AI company recently backed by a Series A financing round, is seeking a talented and visionary Product Designer with a strong command of user interface design to elevate the intuitive nature and value of our SaaS platform through innovative designs rooted in customer feedback.


About Us

Founded in 2019 by two best friends, Jon and Eli, XILO set out to revolutionize the insurance industry by solving its biggest challenges. Eli, a brokerage owner, brought invaluable industry expertise, while Jon, an experienced software engineer, saw an opportunity to innovate using technology. Initially launched as a vertical SaaS solution addressing core quoting challenges, XILO has since evolved into a trailblazing Vertical AI company leveraging the latest AI technology to transform the industry. By layering cutting-edge AI solutions onto its SaaS platform, XILO is driving innovation far beyond its original vision. Having recently closed our Series A funding round, XILO is growing rapidly and seeking talented individuals who want to do career-defining work in a mission-driven startup that’s at the forefront of AI innovation.


About The Role

As a Product Designer at XILO, you’ll play a critical role in shaping the entire user experience, from initial concept to final visual design. By turning customer insights into impactful and aesthetically pleasing designs, you’ll make our products more intuitive, self-servicing, and valuable. You will be responsible for the end-to-end design process, working closely with engineers and other stakeholders to deliver high-fidelity, implementation-ready designs ahead of schedulethat are directly aligned with customer needs.


Key Responsibilities

  • Conduct 3 customer interviews with a Product Manager weekly to gather actionable feedback for design improvements.
  • Create wireframes, mockups, and high-fidelity prototypes using Figma that effectively communicate design concepts 2 sprints ahead of engineering timelines.
  • Develop and maintain a consistent and visually compelling UI across the entire platform.
  • Leverage data pipelines to inform and enhance design decisions.
  • Ensure all current products are intuitive and self-servicing for users.
  • Drive improved adoption and engagement across all current products.


What we’re looking for

  • Extremely curious and inquisitive, with a passion for understanding user needs.
  • Highly tech-savvy and comfortable designing for complex systems.
  • A deep, almost spiritual design philosophy that prioritizes the customer experience.
  • Skilled in conducting customer interviews and synthesizing insights into actionable designs.
  • Proven expertise in UI design, with a strong portfolio showcasing your work with design systems, mockups, and prototypes.
  • Quick learner who can master the industry and product in a short time.
  • Extensive knowledge of design principles, UX/UI best practices, and proficiency in modern design tools.
  • Relentless work ethic: willing to go the extra mile (10+ hours daily when needed).
  • No ego and a mindset of continuous learning and collaboration.
  • Builds genuine relationships with team members and customers.
  • Positive, motivating, and supportive team player.
  • Accountable for successes and failures, with a focus on doing the job right.
  • Balances leadership with hands-on contributions (player-coach mentality).
  • Passionate about AI and its potential to transform industries


What we offer

  • Collaborative and innovative work environment.
  • Flex PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits), flexible work schedule.
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health and wellness package.
  • Budget for English lessons.


Why Join XILO?

Be part of a mission-driven team at the forefront of AI innovation and SaaS technology. As a Product Designer at XILO, you’ll have the opportunity to own the user experience and interface of a cutting-edge platform, deliver career-defining work, and make a lasting impact on a rapidly growing company.


At XILO, we don’t stop until the job is done. If you’re ready to roll up your sleeves, embrace challenges, and make a meaningful impact, we’d love to hear from you.


Apply only if you’re ready to invest in your success and build a lasting career.

title: Senior Full Stack Software Engineer
description:
We are seeking a remote, full-time Senior Full Stack Software Engineer with 5+ years of software development experience. Candidates must have a strong background in React.js and experience with either Golang, Node.js, or Java, with a strong desire to adopt Golang as the primary back-end technology.

In this position, you will play a foundational role in building the core platform that enables power utilities to shift from decades-old legacy systems into an AI-native future. Candidates must bring working proficiency with AI tools and APIs to ensure seamless integration of intelligent functionality into the client's products.

This role requires strong coding fundamentals, system design capability, and the mindset of a builder who thrives in a startup environment. You will work in small, agile teams reporting directly to the CTO, collaborating closely with AI engineers, security leaders, and product managers. Together, you will build and deliver AI-native services delivered at startup speed.

Our client is building an AI-centric operating system for utilities. It harnesses AI at the enterprise level to better orchestrate customer delight, facilitate power optimization, improve the health of the grid, and unlock flexibility at scale. Funded by a strategic industry partner and one of the founders at Groupon, the client is poised to transform how utilities run and how customers experience energy.

  • Back-End Architecture & Development : Design, implement, and maintain APIs, services, and distributed systems that form the backbone of the client's OS
  • AI Integration : Collaborate with AI engineers to integrate models, embeddings, and agent services into back-end systems. Operate AI APIs, ensuring outputs are production-ready and aligned with enterprise utility requirements.
  • System Modernization : Transform legacy workflows into modern, secure, scalable codebases using cloud-native best practices
  • Security & Compliance : Partner with security leaders to ensure all services adhere to stringent utility-sector regulations, implementing secure coding practices by default
  • Agile Delivery : Deliver features and improvements in cycles measured in weeks, balancing speed with reliability


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 5+ years of software engineering experience in SaaS or enterprise environments
  • Strong proficiency in React, Python, and either Golang, Node.js, or Java (non-Golang developers will learn and adopt Golang on the job)
  • Demonstrated ability to deliver high-quality code in fast-moving teams
  • Basic proficiency with AI/ML tooling (e.g., calling APIs, integrating model outputs)
  • Solid understanding of databases (SQL and NoSQL), message queues, and distributed architectures
  • Cloud-native engineering experience (AWS, Azure, GCP)
  • Clear communicator, adaptable, eager to learn and grow AI capabilities over time
  • Strong sense of ownership and accountability in small teams


Desired Experience

  • University degree or relevant industry experience
  • Experience working on ERP systems or within the power utilities industry


Additional Information

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. title: Head of Product Design (UI/UX, AI-Forward) - Contractor Role
description:
Head of Product Design (UI/UX, AI-Forward) - Contractor


Downstream · Open to employees in Argentina, Bolivia, Brazil, Chile, Colombia, Ecuador, Guyana, Paraguay, Peru, Suriname, Uruguay, Venezuela


About Downstream


Downstream is transforming the construction industry by building a marketplace for equipment rentals, portable toilets, and roll-off dumpsters. We are scaling fast. Our vision: bring price transparency, automation, and intelligence into one of the most manual, underserved verticals in the economy.


We’re inspired by clean design and modern architecture—and we’re pushing forward with AI-native product thinking, not bolting it on later.


The Role


We’re hiring a Head of Product Design (UI/UX) who is obsessed with creating intuitive, elegant, and impactful user experiences. You’ve shipped something before—whether at a startup that scaled, a product that users loved, or a platform that redefined a workflow. You know the pain of turning complex problems into simple, usable solutions, and you want another shot at shaping an industry from 0 → 1.


At Downstream, you’ll work directly with our CEO, CTO, and Product team to:

  • Define and own the design vision for our marketplace, supplier tools, and customer experience.
  • Lead end-to-end design for web and mobile, including UX flows, UI systems, and visual identity.
  • Architect AI-native product experiences that feel intuitive, not artificial—helping users trust automation and agents in critical workflows.
  • Collaborate with engineers and product managers to ship fast: prototype, test, iterate, and refine.
  • Build and scale our design system so we can move quickly without sacrificing quality.


Responsibilities

  • Drive the product design strategy across customer, supplier, and internal platforms.
  • Build and maintain UI/UX standards that reflect simplicity, trust, and efficiency.
  • Design AI-native experiences—where agentic systems interact seamlessly with users, data, and decisions.
  • Conduct user research and usability testing with construction industry stakeholders.
  • Mentor and grow a design team as we scale.


What We’re Looking For

  • Battle-tested designer: You’ve shipped real products (startup, marketplace, SaaS, or similar).
  • AI-forward mindset: You don’t just add AI—you design around it, making it feel natural and empowering.
  • Builder’s DNA: Comfortable with ambiguity, speed, and iteration. You’ve felt the pain of building in the real world and still want more.
  • Technical & design skills:
  • UI/UX design (Figma, Sketch, or equivalent)
  • Strong UX research and prototyping chops
  • Design systems and component libraries
  • Understanding of modern frontend frameworks (bonus: Flutter, React)
  • Experience designing for AI interactions (chat, agents, workflows)
  • Startup mentality: Hands-on, resourceful, willing to go beyond your job title.
  • Industry experience: Construction tech or marketplaces a huge plus—someone who can empathize with our users.


Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience in marketplaces, logistics, SaaS, or fintech.
  • Familiarity with B2B workflows and procurement tools.
  • Contributions to open-source design systems or AI products.


Why Downstream

  • Early-stage, high-growth startup with real traction.
  • Work with a small, sharp, and ambitious product + engineering team.
  • Opportunity to shape AI-native product experiences in an industry that hasn’t seen this level of innovation before.
  • Competitive salary + equity

title: Staff Software Engineer (Backend)
description:
About Artisan

At Artisan, we’re building real AI employees - not copilots, not assistants, but autonomous teammates.


Our first, Ava, is an AI BDR. She finds and researches leads, writes emails in customers’ tone of voice, runs outbound sequences, self-optimizes, and manages email deliverability infrastructure. She learns, adapts, and improves over time - just like a human would.


Human team members use Artisan as their primary working platform, replacing a sprawling stack of sales tools, and have Artisans working alongside them.


We went through Y Combinator (W24) and have raised $35M+ from top investors. We’re at $7M+ ARR, with hundreds of customers including Remote, Quora, and SumUp. We’re currently working on Ava 2.0, pushing the boundaries of what an AI employee can do. And we're hiring.


Your Mission

You’ll design, build, and scale the backend that powers AI employees while following our principles:

  • Velocity is Everything:  keep the 20/80 rule in mind, delay kills growth
  • Think Like a Founder:  ship with quality, have strong opinions, and speak up if you disagree
  • Operate With Efficiency:  put the customer first, write it down, and use AI wherever possible
  • Communication Rules Everything:  be clear and concise, give candid, unsolicited feedback
  • Meetings, But Make Them Useful:  don’t attend meetings where you don’t add or extract value; Presence ≠ productivity
  • Vibes Matter:  have a positive attitude, make others feel appreciated, we’re here to win


What You Bring

  • 6+ years of backend engineering experience in high-growth environments, preferably early-stage or Series B.
  • Strong experience building scalable, data-intensive services with modern APIs and robust infrastructure.
  • Proficiency with AWS and GitHub Actions.
  • Deep understanding of distributed systems, APIs, reliability, performance, and database systems (SQL + NoSQL).
  • Experience with modern stacks - TypeScript/Node preferred, but equivalent backend stacks are welcome.
  • Demonstrated track record of ownership - leading parts of systems independently and shipping with impact.
  • Excellent communication, clarity in articulating architecture to technical and non-technical stakeholders.


What Makes This Role Stand Out

  • Stay relevant:  At Artisan we are creating AI employees and you'll learn how to not be replaced by one.
  • Ownership and autonomy:  You'll be given trust, and expected excellence.
  • Compensation:  Real equity upside and compensation aligned with high expectations and high impact.
  • Culture:  Have a chat with our teammates, each and everyone has a clear reason about why they love it.
